item.title: Contenders Voice Report
item.description: The uplifting and enrichment of your soul is within reach, my friend!
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contenders Voice Report on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Jesus, while walking on the shore of the Sea of Galilee, called His first disciples–Peter and Andrew, into His life-changing, transformative discipleship school. He said, “Come, follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men” (Matthew 4:1-9). A dramatic, spiritual transformation was about to begin in the souls of these men and their companions.

Reader, are you marking time? It’s a military term that means “active, but not progressing.” If so, the Scriptures hold good news for you! Here it is!

You are not being overlooked, believer. Rather, you are also called to follow Yeshua as his chosen disciple, and not be left behind to remain only an unmotivated church goer or casual believer. If you commit to live for Him and conform to His instructions–all of which are fundamentally founded upon the unchangeable Torah, you will be spiritually transformed as were the Savior’s early disciples! Think about the magnificent change that occurred in the soul of Apostle Peter, for instance. The dynamic, holy process that shaped him is based upon a life of unmitigated discipleship and holy fellowship with your Messiah by the communion of the Holy Spirit. This is called koinonia, a Greek word meaning “intimate partnership.” Do you want to abide in and be fully cognizant of that sublime and reciprocal fellowship? I certainly do! Luke 5:27; John 10:7-10; Galatians 2:21; Colossians 3:23; 1 Peter 1:9.

But alas, Christian converts usually set out enthusiastically to follow the Messiah, make positive changes in their lives, attend church, and go forward growing in Yahweh’s grace. However, polls reveal that many believers eventually end up being led away from their biblical faith commitment and first love, Messiah Yeshua. This lamentable spiritual devolution is the result of what are usually demonically staged influences. Some even fall away shortly after the dawn of their faith declaration. Hence, may Yeshua’s committed followers remember the parable of the seed and soil, and commit their lives to bearing good fruit to the glory of Yahweh-some of us 30 fold, some 60 fold, and others 100 fold. Amen. Matthew 13:1-23. For which number are you aiming, reader?

In any case, church attendees from America’s varied westernized denominations, and sometimes even “journeymen congregants,” have been found to turn away from assemblies which render spiritually lackluster Bible teachings, usually disregard serious discipleship training, and restrict the ministry of the Holy Spirit. Hugh voids, for sure! These religious organizations do not exalt Yeshua-by failing to vigorously promote His authority as their High Priest, King, and Judge. What’s more, many spiritually vitiated congregations underplay the Scripture’s clear instructions on holiness, sanctification, and righteousness. The unchallenged attendees of these organizations usually end up deprived of prophetic vision and purpose, and thus find and entertain alternate but unbiblical excitements and intrigues. In any case, fledging progress taken by a saint toward (1) genuine discipleship, (2) spiritual enlightenment, and (3) the gradual transformation of the soul, is undermined severely if they turn away from unimpeded love for Yeshua and seeking first and foremost the Kingdom of God. Everything else is secondary. The alternative of infernal, anti-Messiah teachings and fantasies proffered by teachers and influencers is damnation, not a glorious eternity with our beloved Savior. Pray for a real revival-a Whole Truth revival.

These arrogant heretics are actually spiritual terrorists who either misunderstand or purposely distort the Scriptures to support their evil intentions. Their deceptions come crafted to deceive gullible unschooled believers and even veteran saints, and lead them through the Wide Gate to the Broad Way upon which countless others march toward damnation and oblivion. Be warned, saint! Nobody is exempt from the craftiness of Satan, the father of lies. He has been a murderer from the beginning…and he and his demonic hordes want your soul. Matthew 7:13-14; John 8:44.

I want to point out a few prominent false teachings that are circulating today. Avoid them. These falsehoods include caricatures of sound doctrinal truths such as the Noahic Covenant Movement, Heavenly Journeying, Christian Nationalism, Hyper-grace Faith, the Follow Your Heart Message, the New Apostolic Reformation as it stands, also Christian Zionism, and politically driven Christianity. These are long term religious campaigns drawing people away from the Jewish Messiah, His Gospel and teachings, and from seeking the Kingdom of God and His righteousness.

Aligning one’s heart and soul with worldly ideologies, such as those cited above, and favoring errant versions and blending mystical practices with Christianity has proven to be spiritually perilous. By doing so a deceived supporter knits his or her soul and world view into a false theology and a predictably ill-fated future on the Broad Way to hell, as mentioned earlier. Instead, dear saint, choose to commit your entire life to something with a glorious future–which is learning and complying with the words and ways of the Messiah. As Peter declared that Yeshua has “the words of eternal life” (John 6:68). You are called to be a Spirit-filled, Messiah-focused disciple also, and happily obedient to the whole Word of God–-all that is known, applicable, and doable. Such is the natural commitment of believers endorsed by sound biblical “faith.” And the key to spiritual growth and cohesiveness are small discipleship groups that meet, not as church service, but for discipleship studies that use applicable, suitable courses, and encourage fellowship.

Discipleship groups and members may or may not be connected to a church. Notwithstanding, in time many will gravitate to a valid expression of Hebraic faith such as turning away from Sunday to the true Saturday Sabbath is an example. Discipleship groups need not be large classes, nor imitate church services and programs. Discipleship groups are distinctively different. They are actually small schools of Scripture study and sharing.

Consider the Berean Jews who, under Apostle Paul’s focused tutelage, met regularly but not in a crowded disparate, anti Messiah synagogue. They met in a small, disciplined group and became disciples of the risen Messiah. In discipleship groups the Holy Spirit is the Headmaster. Growing in the likeness of Yeshua is the goal. Godly male leadership is the biblical standard. And this standard must be returned to the Ecclesia.

When you know who you truly are, dear Christian believer, messianic discipleship will seem natural to you, and very desirable–- and absolutely necessary! Gentile believers who are “born again” are united with Yeshua and one another by the New Covenant. They are Torah focused and comprise Redeemed Israel, along with Spirit regenerated Messianic Jews. Those of the returning House of Israel are not called to follow Rabbinic Judaism, the Talmud or Targum, the Kabbalah nor the esoteric writings of the Zohar, or worldly-wise churches riddled with the ideas of wandering teachers. Saints born of the Spirit of Elohim are being called back to the Torah and the restoration of the fallen foundations of the original Nazarene faith before it was compromised.

Hence, we recognize the responsibility to address religious or political abuse when such is needed. And we reserve the right to speak out against any form of persecution. Further, it is the duty of sanctified saints to openly question and challenge American, Israeli, and other influential entities whose religious and political protocols are perceived to be extreme or dehumanizing, deceptive, or politically dishonest. This “watchman” charge is the obligation of today’s Spirit-born New Covenant servants of the Most High Elohim, even as it was for the prophets and apostles. Such is encompassed in a true blessing ministered in love. Let us not be found liars or cowards. See Revelation 21:8.

Accurate understanding of the Scriptures should propel us to be genuine doers of the sacred word of Yahweh. Consider the next few reminders:

1. “It is by grace that you are saved through faith; it is not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: not of works, lest any man should boast” (Ephesians 2:8-9). Note: You are not saved by works. However, you are saved and empowered by the indwelling Holy Spirit, for works. Why else would the Law of Yahweh have been written on your new heart and infused into your mind? It is by the Spirit of Elohim that saints are inspired to obey the words and ways of our Messiah. This willing compliance is the pure biblical expression of unfeigned love for God and man.

2. “Marvel not that I said unto thee [Nicodemus], You must be born-again…of the Spirit” (see John 3:7 and 8). Note: And be baptized with the Holy Spirit. This is essential.

3. “Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a New Covenant with the House of Israel and the House of Judah. But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the House of Israel: After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God and they will be my people” (See Jeremiah 31:31-33). Note: The House of Israel is returning to the Father’s house and his Torah.

4. “And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit [heart] within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them: and they shall be my people…” (Ezekiel 11:19-20). Note: New Birth miracles. Yahweh re-establishing Israel.

5. “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whether they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land: And i will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of israel…” (See Ezekiel 37:15-28). Note: Israel and Judah will be reunited and the whole House of Jacob will be restored to their ancient land, Israel.

6. “For this is the covenant that I will make with the House of Israel after those days, saith the LORD; I will put my laws into their mind and write them in their hearts, and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people” (Hebrews 8:10). Yahweh wants close fellowship with them who want to conform to His will. Note: His Law, quite obviously, has never been abolished. Instead, by divine decree and power, His Torah commandments have been transferred from scrolls and tablets, and miraculously placed into the believer’s mind and written on the new heart. This holy phenomenon is called spiritual regeneration which occurs through faith in Yeshua and His atonement.

7. “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power and of love, and of a sound mind” (2 Timothy 1:7). Note: You are miraculously gifted with faith, hope, love, and the joy of the Lord. Rejoice and be glad!

8. “Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all long suffering and doctrine” (2 Timothy 4:2). Note: This is how you bless Abraham’s descendents, and Yeshua’s Ecclesia. Speaking the truth in love, even as it can be supportive or constitutes a blessing. So do not be afraid and remain silent in the face of wrongdoing. Such a non-response can imply consent.

Let’s cut to the Chase The westernized Christian faith must recover and restore the original Torah-based, Spirit-led, apostolic faith of the early Nazarene Judeans. It’s doctrines and traditions were taught by the Yeshua and the apostles, and were handed down to the saints to guard and maintain for the coming generations. Nothing needed to be added, changed, or removed. Consider Jude 1:3. In any case, you are in a position to bring the full measure of Yahweh’s truth into your life and fellowship. In closing, I present you with this question: According to Scriptural standards, are you a genuine disciple of Yeshua Hamashiach? Answer honestly. Yes? No? Send me your answer.

Tamid Kadima–Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

Note: Contenders Voice–First Generation is concluded. We will continue with Second Generation–Weekly Parsha Applications and opening our Torah and Glory School’s first course–in March.

item.title: Contenders Voice Report
item.description: America lies beneath the power of the evil one. Actually, we're under an infernal "spell." However, Yeshua's people can abide securely under the Shadow of the Almighty. Do not not be drawn away.
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contenders Voice Report on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

It is written: “We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies under the sway of the wicked one” (1 John 5, verse 19). Satan is “the wicked one” of whom Apostle John speaks. And he, who is also the Devil, is the adversary of God and accuser of His people. He and his legions of demonic spirits and fallen angels, along with His enslaved human henchmen, conspire to coax mankind to the broad road leading to condemnation, and from it to the Sulphur Lake. Revelation 19:20; 21:8.

Therefore, be especially watchful in this tumultuous hour of mass media’s misleading information and promotions. Be discerning, and do not automatically believe every human teacher or influencer, but test each one and discern whether he or she is of God or of the wicked one. This is wisdom.

Did you know, dear reader, that approximately 15,000 churches closed in America last year, in 2025? And as the modern Ekklesia has ventured forward into 2026, we have discovered that Christian ministries are still continuing to hemorrhage members. Why? What’s the core problem? Well, here it is! Generation upon generation of converts, church goers, and elders as well, have opted for casual, comfortable, and world-friendly lives of faith. Most Bible assemblies, especially the historic large ones, overlook exhorting their congregants to follow the righteous standards of the Scriptures, thinking that such an expectation opposes God’s grace. However, this notion finds absolutely no support in the Bible.

Satan’s standing order: Confuse, Divide and Scatter the Sheepfold.

In any case, today’s Christianity-at-large suffers from another blunder. America’s traditional faith, by and large, fails to honor the duty and demands of messianic discipleship. What’s more, traditional church congregations are not educated or equipped to resist the manifold works of demonic energy, thus freeing them to continue their infernal wickedness! See Matthew 28:19-20 and Ephesians 6:12-18. This indifference to Scriptural teaching has proven to be catastrophic. It has fashioned and brought forth a westernized, casual church that exists uncommitted to (1) the Holy Spirit’s full power, (2) sanctification, and (3) the unblemished instructions and absolute authority of our beloved Redeemer, Messiah Yeshua of the Tribe of Judah. This country’s lamentable spiritual condition is tantamount to modern Christianity being lukewarm and lacking an expected measure of true devotion to the Savior? What do you think, believer? See Revelation 2, verse 4.

A plea from Apostle Paul: “I appeal to you, brothers, to watch out for those [wolves] who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to doctrine that you have been taught; avoid them” (Romans 16:17-18).

Wolf Packs. Don’t snicker, dear reader, but you must be warned. Wolves are stalking and pulling apart Messiah’s blessed Ekklesia, one careless saint after another. From a distance these beasts may look like friendly, tail wagging dogs, but happy canines they definitely are not. These creatures are ravenous predators that seek to devour weak, inattentive prey. Hence, “wolf pack” is a fitting metaphor characterizing false teachers who are driven by demons and the wicked powers of the high places to ravage Yeshua’s sheepfold and undermine its potential for missions and spiritual warfare. The false teachings strategically planted by “wolves” are decoys that draw believers from Kingdom of God realities to erroneous doctrines and time consuming secondary commitments. The purpose of false teachers then, is to confuse and deceive believers, corrupt their faith, stir unbelief, and scatter them from their earthly ministries and God-given eternal destiny. In this age of advanced technology deceptive human heretics are so bold and prolific that they don’t even bother to hide under sheepskins to foist their false teachings. Point:

The misleading doctrines and lifeless sermons of wolves abound even more today. They can be delivered personally–as in ancient times, but also from elevated assembly platforms, or even by the media’s multiple avenues. Their subtle attacks on sound biblical dogma can be unrelenting, and pervasive indeed. In this way, today’s wolves can manipulate inadequately disciplined, casual believers. They are weak prey and subject to bogus gospel presentations and adulterated Bible lessons. Indeed, false teachings are decoys. Hence, the command of Yeshua comes to mind: “Follow Me.”

Conclusion: Be discerning, Saint. It is written: “But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we have preached to you, let him be accursed” (Galatians 1:8). With this verse Paul does not refer to the New Testament epistles that had already been written. Rather, it references the false teaching being used by hardened heretical teachers who, like cold wolves, sought to lead people away from pure Gospel honesty. Therefore, beloved believers, read the Scriptures and start conforming to their instructions. Don’t defer any longer. And do not cherry pick undemanding favorites. In addition, commit to messianic discipleship. In this way you will be highly blessed, supported by the grace of Yahweh, and be spiritually uplifted by developing friendship-fellowship with your resurrected Savior.

Next: Wolf Progeny [offspring] – and Wolf Tares. Do not overlook the next report. It applies to you individually, Believer, and your future in America’s evolving faith-based organizations. Remember, His word is a lamp unto your feet, and a light unto your path. From Psalm 119:105.

Stay on the narrow road, friend, and follow the Holy Spirit’s leading. In doing so you will experience good things unfold in your life. And keep in mind, dear contender—the enemy’s demonic power and spells are broken off our own lives and the Ecclesia also. Deliverance comes by faith, the declaration of Yahweh’s applicable Word, and unswerving obedience to His truth, which is the key. Deliverance for America starts and continues with one saint at a time. Perhaps with you! Amen

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

item.title: Contenders Voice--Welcome aboard!
item.description: “No one can serve two masters…” (Matthew 6:24).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contenders Voice--Welcome aboard! on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Modern churchgoer, who or what is your real master--or to whose words and ways is your life aligned? Perhaps you might say or even think, “I don’t really have a master. Nobody dominates me entirely.” Well, I would sincerely urge you to think again. Why? Because you, and everyone else on this planet, do have one master or another! The words of Scripture clearly inform the reader who they are. So contemplate your life for a moment, and while you do, know this for sure: whose words and standards you adhere to and follow, his servant you are reckoned to be. Consider Romans 6:16.

America first? Israel first? Or Kingdom of God first?

Have you, dear Christian, been persuaded by the compelling influences of assorted religious and political pressures that abound today? Have they influenced you to such an extent that you’ve blended them in with your biblical beliefs thereby compromising your faith commitment to some degree and diverting your focus away from Yeshua and His mission? These occurrences are common. Deceptive influences, that are in fact spiritual decoys that seize the attention of many saints, mix with and vitiate pure apsotolic faith. Consider what is written:“Do not yoke an ox and a donkey to a plow” (from Deuteronomy 22:10). The two different animals are unequal partners and cannot work together to plough a straight furrow. Their rows will not be in line but curved, going this way and that, and will end up winding all over the field. This is a good metaphor. Dear friends, heed divine counsel and use common sense. Do not yoke together man’s words, ideas, social programs, and worldly excitements by uniting them with the pure, harmonious Word of God. Accordingly, to whom have you yoked yourself? Are you ploughing a straight row in your faith-field? Selah.

Such present day adverse influences are like the mythological sirens of Ulysses who, from dangerous shores, lured beguiled seamen with irresistible angelic singing to turn their wooden ships toward the rocky beaches and to the sailors’ doom. Demonic influences are doing the same sort of thing today with believers. They are beguiling modern church goers and their leaders with alluring, secondary pursuits that can compromise their heavenly faith and service. Infernal powers seek to divert our attention away from the Messiah’s Kingdom and making disciples, to become preoccupied with worldly affairs and various subordinate issues. Again, it’s happening as you read.

Here’s the point. Though tempted daily, all of us who follow the Son of God must never exchange our steadfast devotion for Yeshua and His blessed Word for loyalty to the world’s cultural campaigns, political promotions, or ideological intrigues. Yeshua never even hinted that His followers should tread that wide earthy road. Political start-ups and their justification, touted nation building campaigns, hybrid spiritual dogma, et al, fall way behind Yeshua’s command to seek first His kingdom. Mixing such things into our uncompromised, apostolic Torah-rooted dogma does not serve us, the Ecclesia, or society well at all. Such priorities compromise the needed but scarce ministry of salt and light spoken of by Yeshua. Matthew 5:13-16. Our venerated, divinely sanctioned biblical faith does not share its spotlight on Yeshua or His Kingdom with secular New Age spiritual trends and developments. Nor is the Master going to blend His pure, Torah based instructions together with the words, plans or programs of corrupt worldly leaders or councils, religious or otherwise. His followers must stand firmly with Him and not be persuaded to shift their focus from the Kingdom of God to the many quasi-religious and ephemeral political distractions this fallen world has to offer. So, who is your master?

Such is the character of western Christendom. This religious colossus of jumbled dogma produces spiritual conflation and weakness as the corrupted cultures of today’s struggling nations, especially America, loudly bear witness. Rather, hold on to your pure, most holy faith and the holy standards of the Word of Yahweh in which Yeshua is central. Unadulterated Scripture must remain pristine. No mixing or false teaching are allowed to contaminate the “faith once for all delivered to the saints.” See Jude 1:3. We are saved for discipleship. It is the way of the followers and students of the Messiah. Each of us can become His loyal learner as we seek first Kingdom of God and His righteousness. Spirit born saints are all enabled to mature in the Messiah’s likeness. And as we mature as disciples, we make disciples also! It is our calling, even our duty. Let’s put away seeking first our kingdom and our comfort. It is infinitely better to remain steadfast as His servant and friend who hears the Good Shepherd’s voice and follows Him on the narrow road of the Torah’s truth and the Spirit’s power. Everything else, even that which seemingly holds importance and requires attention, is secondary, tertiary, and even behind those. Check everything out with the Word of God. It is your life.

The first question returns again: Who or what is your master? Declare it out loud! Bonus question: Upon what are you building the faith foundation of your life? Is it sand, or sand mixed with a few rocks, or solid rock alone? Confess your answer loudly! See Matthew 7:24-27.

Here is your Prophetic Word, blessed Saint: It is written: “I myself will prepare your way, leveling mountains and hills” (Isaiah 45:2 GNT). Pray and declare Yahweh’s promises over the varied circumstances of your life, including all the mountainous challenges that you face. You are redeemed by faith in the shed blood of the Lamb, Yeshua. So wait patiently in faith for His favor and word to be fulfilled right on time! He is your Master. May you have a blessed day. Amen.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church Shalom.

item.title: Contenders Voice- Blessing and Cursing Part 2
item.description: Is modern, westernized Christianity still a genuine Messiah-centered faith?
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contenders Voice- Blessing and Cursing Part 2 on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

It is written: “We must no longer be children, tossed to and fro and blown about by every wind of doctrine, by people’s trickery, by their craftiness in deceitful scheming” (Ephesians 4:14). Guard your faith, folks. Unholy deceptive influences are increasingly active in these latter days. Believers must keep themselves focused on Messiah Yeshua and be not distracted by the daily flood of mis-information inundating and propagandizing America. Toward that end I present the following questions for you.

What is your chief spiritual interest, dear reader? Think! As a westernized Christian, where do the crosshairs of your primary religious attention lie? Is it just the maintenance of your religious status quo? Or is it something that seems visionary but actually displaces the risen Messiah? For instance, is your preference a form of Christianity that’s mixed with politics? Or maybe you have been drawn toward international Zionism, or manifold mysticism, or ecumenical unity, or a demonic decoy of some kind. It’s also apparent that modern Christian nationalism holds fast the attention of many dominion-oriented believers today? However, if you are stable and unwavering in your doctrine it could be that your focus is truly prophetic and consequently you are involved with the foremost need of the vulnerable, western Ecclesia. And that genuine “need” would be the restoration of the Messiah-centric, apostolic Nazarene faith–called the “Way” by the early Judaens. In any case, just as was with the original saints, we also have been given Yahweh’s prime directive . It is: “Seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness” (Mt. 6:33). This priority was foundational to the original Nazarene assemblies and was taught by the apostles. So remember, there is only one “first” and for the saints of this era and that “first” remains. It is the resolute, steadfast focus of all disciples on the person, life and words of Messiah Yeshua! Every other interest or attraction, no matter how attractive or seeming noble, is secondary.

Paul was clear concerning the matter. He declared: “For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Yeshua HaMashiach and Him crucified” (1 Corinthians 2:2). Unlike many western Christians of this era, when earthly intrigues presented themselves Paul was not distracted and did not wobble in his convictions nor be moved away from his loyalty for the Messiah. He stood steadily upon the scriptural truth passed onto him by Yeshua. Consequently Paul was thus qualified to address the Jewish believers who were being persecuted and distracted by misinformation peddled by prejudiced deceptive Judaizers.The apostle would address today’s Christians this way:“Do not be led astray by various kinds of strange teachings” (Hebrews 13:9). Direct. Simple. No mincing of words here. His instructions are for you.

Dear saints, this is both a command and a warning that should be taken seriously. Messiah is being pushed aside too often for new faith intrigues. Be sober. Be sensible and serious concerning the verse.The adversary is seeking whom he may distract, capture and destroy. Evil spirits want to capture our interest, refocus our loyalty, and take our souls to perdition. The prophesied “falling away” phenomenon has begun and it is dissuading the faithful and encompassing a growing number of apostates who are turning away from the clean biblical truth they once embraced. This current rebellion clearly reveals that Yeshua’s ill-equipped Ecclesia is inadequately prepared for intensive, long term spiritual warfare. Compromised American and European Christianity definitely needs to undergo a complete restoration of (1) the Spirit’s power, (2) the Torah’s un-compromised truth, (3) the centrality and authority of King Yeshua, and (4) the vital practice of biblical discipleship. This requirement goes well beyond today’s limited, westernized denominational training for converts.

Believership or Discipleship.

Believership is good. It’s a start. Discipleship is commanded and far better. It’s obedience. Actually, Disciples making Disciples is best. It’s prophetic, yet it remains a practice that is conspicuously absent in the westernized Ecclesia, apart from large classes and such. Nevertheless, it is Yeshua’s prime directive. Our Messiah’s restored Ecclesia–which is redeemed Israel in the wilderness of the world, is being spiritually prepared for the tumultuous days that lie ahead. Therefore dear reader, stand firmly in your unmixed biblical truth, and become immoveable by distracting infernal persuasions. And abide in a state of inner clarity, practice holiness, and remain entirely aligned with the Messiah’s righteous character and sacred instructions. Do not exchange your concentration on Yeshua for preoccupation with spiritual fads or mixing into your pure faith various unbiblical pursuits and ideologies. Spiritual warfare is intensifying. Loyalty is your standard and safe base. Become a disciple who makes disciples. Matthew 28; Romans 1 and 16.

Modern political and religious persuasions are coaxing many saints away from their wholehearted, undivided devotion to their Savior and reverence for the sacred authority of Scripture. Days of strong spiritual adversity have arrived and the prophesied time of “falling away” is upon us. Spiritual deception, gross apostasy, the embrace of nationalism and worldly values,and the lawlessness that is rife in Catholicism and Protestantism has corrupted and rendered westernized Christianity in western nations weak and overlooked. 2 Thessalonians 2:3. This lamentable and very hurtful condition is the result of Christian ministry leaders foolishly mixing pure truth with worldly visions and values, and uniting with cultural campaigns for change. These pursuits are secondary and tertiary interests, not foremost as is seeking the Kingdom of God and His righteousness. And here lies the chief problem among believers. It is not just the huge lack of enlightenment, discernment and wisdom among the saints. It is the underlying confusion comes from the churches with the world’s kingdoms and pursuits it over dedication and identification with the Kingdom of God, its Sovereign, Yeshua our Messiah, and reaching the world with their pure, Torah based Gospel. An enduring revival will occur in the land once we turn back to the original Nazarene faith. I think it’s stirring in America right now.

Conclusion: America, and other nations as well, is undergoing existential political and economic upheaval, as you well know. The list of contributing forces include: tech dominance, economic coercion, weaponization of resources, and civil disorders that require urban military interventions. But let’s not leave out other prominent forces that have also furthered our social demise. These pressures would be government surveillance, secular and spiritual lawlessness, manipulative foreign alliances, the collapse of biblical morality, and other unspecified pressures that are also corralling countries like ours and channeling them into the antichrist New World Order forecasted long ago. These circumstances are generated by unseen dark spiritual forces and their captured and controlled human reprobates. It has become obvious. There will be no turning back to the so-called good old days. Hence, it’s high time…even past high time, for all Spirit-born saints to honestly evaluate the (1) true focus of our faith and (2) its demonstrative purpose in our lives. Friends, we must each truthfully admit our findings–-whether or not MessiahYeshua and His Word are really the focus of our faith or if we have shifted our focus away to something else. Or is our primary interest and focus foreign to the Gospel but mixed with faith in Messiah anyway. Does our doctrine compromise our loyalty to the Savior? Undeviating allegiance to Adonai our risen King precedes everything. Compromise is an enemy.

Consider the wise Ephraimite Joshua? He publicly avowed his authentic uncompromised Torah-based faith before the varied people of Israel, all of whom needed the assurance of their new leader..“As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD” (Joshua 24:15). He did not waver. It may be time for you to unequivocally confess your spiritual position, that is, to proclaim your devotion toYeshua as Savior and your unmixed focus upon His instructions.. Follow the bold warrior’s example and give your life in service to King Yeshua. By doing so, you will be blessed while the demonic enemies of your soul fall under your feet.

PNW/CV/ Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church-Host. Shalom.

item.title: Contenders Voice Report
item.description: Blessing and Cursing. You Decide. Part One
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contenders Voice Report on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Now YHWH said to Avram: “I will bless them who bless you, and curse him that curses you, and in you shall all the mishpachot, or families, of the earth be blessed.” See Genesis 12:1-3; Restoration Scriptures.

To whom is that Scripture verse referring? It invites different points of view. So who are those “givers” that should provide the blessing? And who are the “receivers” that should be blessed and not cursed? The “blessers” and “blessees” should be distinguished since Abraham’s descendants and Israel and even the Ecclesia of Yahweh are both the legal candidates. So, who are the blessees? Well, actually both. Then who are the blessers? Again, both. How? Because both are the seed of Abraham.

In any case, the Scripture points to those who should be blessed and not cursed. These people, the first ones pointed out, would be the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. The men became the Hebrew Patriarchs from whom the Messiah would eventually emerge. This nation includes Judah, eventually all the tribes of Israel, and their companions, wherever they are found abiding. May they be the “receivers” of righteous blessings only, and pass such along to others. And may curses not take root among the Hebrews or their progeny but be uprooted and dispersed by the Spirit’s inspired utterances of life and victory. However, let’s be clear about blessing. That which is in alignment with God’s righteousness, whether it be persons or a cause, qualifies to be blessed. However, that which which is distressing, unkind, and contrary to the moral principles of Scripture should not be blessed or approved, but rebuked and condemned. The genocide that has occurred in Gaza is an example of an unholy, infernal protocol.

The non-Israelite servants of Yeshua, His Spirit-born Christian disciples, are expected to share with Abraham descendants righteous and biblically sound blessings in accordance with their fundamental scriptural needs, challenges, and especially confirmations of their prophetic destiny. This is good! But believers in Messiah Yeshua must also bless (1) all Yahweh’s Israel--whether the nation is fully in the land now or not. Israel comprises the House of Judah which has absorbed the tribes of Benjamin and Levi. Included also the few stragglers of the Northern Kingdom who eventually made it south and mixed into Judah. And then there are the faithful converts to Judaism who follow the Torah. This mixed multitude, wherever they are spread today, constitute Israel. But there are also the returning Spirit-born descendants of the House of Israel coming into the New Covenant and returning to the Father’s house and instructions. And finally, include the standing worldwide Ecclesia. These comprise a multitude of varied people, even many who are persecuted saints. The are found among the nations and have also been born of the Holy Spirit through faith in the risen Messiah.

Consequently, the “blesser” should indeed be the international Ecclesia of Yahweh. These, of course, are well qualified for the work. The Ecclesia is filling up with Spirit-born children of promise and they are descendants of Abraham, not by natural birth but by supernatural birth. Each “born again”saint, whether from Israel or another nation, is a new spiritual creation in the Messiah and is established not by law but by faith. As it is written: “If you are in Christ, then you are Abraham’s offspring [seed], heirs according to promise…” (Galatians 4:22-28).

These ingrafted people of varying ethnicities and cultures, are equal heirs of Yahweh’s (1) gracious gift of Life” (1 Peter 3:7), (2) promised Spirit (3:14; 4:6), (3) renewal in God’s image (Col. 3:10-11), and by divine edit are (4) established as full-fledged citizens of redeemed Israel and partakers of the covenants. What a tremendous gift of grace!! And WE are therefore called and anointed to be “blessers”extraordinaire! Nonetheless, keep in mind that faithful, non-Israelite servants of Messiah qualify to be blessed also. We all need encouragement and assistance from time to time. All those redeemed by faith in the efficacy of the shed blood of Messiah Yeshua of Judah and the House of David, constitute redeemed Israel. Therefore, welcome the saints and bless them all! Do not forget the sobering words spoken by the Holy One of Israel: “And if you curse someone, you are in danger of the fires of hell…” (Matthew 5:22).

To only bless and curse not is a “tall order,” given what we know of human nature. But it is very possible for Christians to fulfill this duty by the power of the indwelling Holy Spirit. See Psalm 122:6; Luke 6:28 and Matthew 5:44.

What is a blessing? It is a means, whether verbal and physical, to express affection, invoke divine encouragement, and provide benevolence. It can include a commitment to help, to pray regularly, share the Gospel, and serve as a watchman as well! After all, Paul expressed the two-fold nature of true blessing this way: “Preach the Word; be ready in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with complete patience and teaching…with all authority (See 2 Timothy 4:2 and Titus 2:15). Thus, there can be both positive and negative aspects to a true blessing which makes it like the two sides of the same coin, so to speak. Or in other words, a blessing can also be compared to a sharp two-edged sword that reaches into the soul with powerful life changing enlightenment and vision. Hence, a blessing is first an expression or gesture that enlightens, encourages, and strengthens the recipients. But secondly, a blessing can also take the form of a question, a disagreement, or a warning, and thus enhance awareness and produce needed corrections. Consequently, a blessing, manifold as it might be, when expressed clearly to Yahweh’s servants will enrich and direct a person or group but also complement the prophetic vision of the sacred Scriptures.

What is a Curse? Well, a curse is a spiked bludgeon, the kind used in European warfare long ago. It can be launched vocally or physically but always purposely. Hence to curse means to purposely inflict harm and debilitation on someone or something. In other words, to curse equates to calling down and activating the varied evils of demonic power onto a target. Curses perpetuate falsehoods, purposely offend, inflict verbal harm and discourage and weaken people of faith and vision. Thus, to curse someone is a gross violation of the second great commandment: “...you shall love thy neighbor as thyself.” See Leviticus 1918. And : “A new command I give you: love one another…” (John 13:34-35). This order speaks of expressing selfless compassion, and sacrificial care for those Messianic saints, whoever they might be, who are serving the LORD in this hour of great challenges and spiritual need.

Learn. It is written: “Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse them” (Romans 12:14). Christian will face slander and false accusations in the days ahead. Be prepared to follow the words of our Savior and to bless the person who mis-speaks over you, beloved saint.

Fundamentally, a blessing is accomplished—first, by daily prayer and intercession; secondly, by the steady proclamation of Torah-based New Testament truth to Israelite unbelievers; thirdly, by supporting Christian and messianic Jewish ministries. Such compassionate and practical efforts are very beneficial and please Yahweh. Such service reveals the heart of His disciples and those who contend for the restoration of Torah truth to the Ecclesia of Messiah Yeshua. Are you a real disciple?

The call to discipleship is a summons to bless His people. Yeshua is described as a rabbi or teacher in the Gospels (John 1:38; 3:2). And His followers were called disciples or students. A disciple is a student expected to learn and grown in knowledge and understanding. By doing so he will become a teacher of other disciples, which is the the lynch pin of effective discipleship. A disciple of Yeshua is a student of God’s Word, and is trained to understand the ways of the Kingdom of God. A disciple lays down his self-life, or soulish life, to carry his cross, and thus gradually becomes transformed into the likeness of his Master. This is liberty and our joy. Therefore, follow your redeemer. Be filled with His spirit and obey His words. Serve others, and bless others to, whether the deserve it or not. To curse someone impedes the Holy Spirit’s work with humanity. To bless someone, especially Israel, facilitates His work. Therefore, dear saint, bless Judah. And bless His Ecclesia. And bless those who slander and curse you.

Next: Contender’s Voice: Blessing and Cursing continued. Part Two:

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Let’s meet at Part Two

item.title: Contender’s Voice Report
item.description: Purpose: To restore the ancient faith foundations to Messiah Yeshua’s westernized Ekklesia
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contender’s Voice Report on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

This is a timely message for you personally, dear reader, because:

1. It is a portal that opens to you clarity concerning the most important but widely neglected Christian responsibility, a privilege for which you are chosen.

2. It is a report that explains the critical faith commitment practiced by the early Ecclesia of the original Twelve Apostles –- the faith which is your true heritage.

3. It is a road sign that directs you to the place of your personal transformation, and genuine friendship-fellowship with your Redeemer, Messiah Yeshua.

This order is written to you: “Take my yoke upon you and learn from Me” (Matthew 11:29). You are being invited to be yoked with Him, dear saint, and be wholly submitted to His entire Word—all that is known, applicable and doable. His Torah and blessed teachings have never been abolished, as you know. That empty notion is entirely unfounded. His sacred, life-enhancing instructions are alive and abundant and run from Genesis through Revelation. Hence, half-hearted conformance to Yahweh’s known and relevant Scriptures by a saint could be construed as an affront, wouldn’t you say? The Savior called such an apathetic faith — “lukewarm.” Re-read Revelation 3 :15-16.

The three statements above apply to the same indispensable, small group spiritual fellowship revealed in the Gospels. They point to a life-long allegiance contrived for equipping the Redeemer’s believers in His ways, truth, and life. In short, it is a fellowship for the zealous students of the Messiah. The Good Shepherd’s twelve appointed apostles form the Gospels’ example of a faith support group that constitutes a blessed fellowship of believers who are ardent students eager to learn of the Master and His Torah based truth. It is the Savior’s template of teaching and effectively equipping His people by way of a small and harmonious group. Remember the Master’s apostles. They were disciples who learned and served together. Their unity constituted the first Messiah centered, Spirit empowered, Torah oriented discipleship. This Spirit and Truth equipping fellowship is the biblical mainstay of messianic growth , personal transformation, sanctification, and living a dynamic, fruit-bearing life that truly reflects the character and divine attributes of the Messiah. We could call “discipleship” Yeshua’s School of Faith. Our article will explain what this life-long, but overlooked commitment to the Good Shepherd and spreading His sacred truth actually means to you, to me, and to the Ekklesia of the future. Matthew 28:18-20.

“Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go onto perfection” (Hebrews 6:1).

Today a heavenly wake-up call is resonating across America. It is the holy summons of the Spirit of Elohim directed to believers, urging us to rise above the spiritual conflation that continues to distort biblical truth, and rather be led by the Holy Spirit back to the divinely sanctioned, pure “faith once for all delivered to the saints” (Jude 1:3). Distortion of the Scriptures and the resultant misunderstandings thereof are caused by Christendom’s acceptance of false doctrines and anti-Torah dogma. Such drains the vitality and inhibits the spiritual maturing of institutionalized Christian religion. Rather than remain below our spiritual potential–-a deficiency that is caused by people believing and acting upon errant teaching, Contender’s Voice teaches that believers should leave the old wineskins behind and enter into the hebraic faith restoration underway. The original New Covenant faith elevates (1) Torah based discipleship training, (2) the full ministry of the Holy Spirit, and (3) the Lordship of Yeshua. And in time disciples, who remain Messiah’s students, will go make disciples in their Scripture classes themselves. Matthe 28:19-20. Every believer is called to be a disciple and live a strong messianic lifestyle…and grow into a blessed overcomer. But remember! Discipline, Devotion to Yahweh’s Instructions, and Teamwork are required. This is your call, dear reader. Nothing less.

It is to this religious status that converts are being drawn and educated, but most have still not embraced the summons. Westernized hybrid Gospel faith is the sandy foundation upon which most believers build their life’s truth foundation and upon it they remain. Nevertheless, the prophetic clock has advanced and the time for Yahweh’s people to leave child-likeness behind and rebuild their faith on the rock of Yeshua’s teaching and proceed onward, even all the way back to the original faith foundation of unabridged Torah based truth. And from that restored spiritual platform believers can rightly serve their heavenly Father and His eternal Son as did twelve apostles–-and do so with divine guidance, undivided loyalty, and uncompromised, pure doctrine. This translates to victory in our spiritual warfare.

But there is a widespread demonic spirit of indifference discouraging and preventing many believers today from advancing to their most blessed spiritual estate ordained for them by the King of Glory. Indeed! Most church goers do not want to leave the old wineskins behind, even if the fellowship’s tenets are faulty, and follow Yeshua as disciples who faithfully abide by His Torah truth and all His applicable instructions. The prospect seems too radical and unsettling! Of course, making significant changes in life is indeed challenging. Yet this reluctance prevents believers from going forward to better things such as (1) intimate fellowship with Yeshua by the communion of the Spirit, (2) greater freedom from besetting sin and unbelief, (3) spiritual maturity with greater knowledge of the Savior, and (4) rising as overcomers of the false works of this world’s darkness…to name a few discipleship blessings.. Review Revelation 2 and 3.

The Bride of Messiah, that is composed of Yeshua’s disciples, are now beginning to make themselves ready for the return of the Messiah. See Revelation 19:7-9. The Bride is a lover of her divine Husband’s Law, a loyal keeper of His seventh day Sabbath, and His companion of His Spirit on the narrow road to eternity. So, if you are really being led by the Holy Spirit, then this is where you, dear reader, are heading. Are you inspired by that prospect? The Ecclesia needs a restoration of strong faith that is based upon unimpaired biblical truth. And discipleship is the linch pin to growing and living in that sublime truth. And it is indispensable for maintaining an enduring revival and restoring the missing faith foundations of the original apostolic, Nazarene Ekklesia. In other words, we must recover the Book of Acts faith of old.

If you truly want to mature spiritually as a servant of the Messiah–- and commit as a student who seeks to mature in the spiritual likeness of Yeshua divine your teacher, then Matthew 16:24 discipleship is your future! Look up the verse.

It is written: “If my people...will pray…and turn from their wicked ways…” (See all of 2 Chronicles 7:14). This is a segment of a famous and often used verse. It tells us that the requirement for a strong and enduring revival is deep repentance. The Hebrew word is teshuva. It means turning completely away from sin and worldliness and going in a different direction–one leading back to the place of original light and truth.

Spirit-powered revival leads to the spiritual transformation of participants by an infusion of vibrant spiritual life and enlightenment. It does not need super stars or a political or patriotic emphasis pushing or sustaining it. Revival is a pure spiritual work of divine grace and mercy wrought by the Holy Spirit. And by it, those truly revived by a Spirit of Truth awakening are exhorted to heed the messages of Yahweh Adonai that (1) exalt His divine Son, Yeshua our soon-coming King, (2) proclaim His unabridged Word, and (3) relate to our eternal interests.

Therefore remember and rejoice that a true revival...

first, occurs through grace alone,

secondly - is received by faith alone,

thirdly - is focused on Messiah Yeshua alone,

fourthly - glorifies God alone, and

fifthly - is founded upon the Holy Scriptures alone. See John 3; Ephesians 2.

Thus we take notice that a true biblical revival is not founded upon, nor sustained by, a memorial service that is politically engineered and undergirded by lobbies. A spiritual awakening and revival are inspired, empowered, and led by the Holy Spirit. Hype is not needed. Such a compassionate phenomenon is energized by common people coming to salvation through faith in the cross, the atoning shed blood, and resurrection of the Son of God. Converts surrender their lives to Him and are counted as a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people of praise. See 1 Peter 2:9. These saints continue in their hebraic heritage and conform to His clear Torah based, biblical instructions. Such believers become fully committed disciples of Yeshua and His Gospel of salvation.They–you and I also, are consequently Kingdom of God patriots whose absolute Sovereign is Yeshua Ha Mashiach. This is your first and foremost alliance on earth, friend. All others follow.

Continuing: The full measure of Spirit and Truth reality once bequeathed by YHWH to the original apostolic Ekklesia is not apparent in the ministries of modern evangelical Ekklesia, and neither in the lives of modern individual saints as well. It’s true that Post-Reformation Christianity has functioned globally with missions, performed good social works, trumpeted moral standards, and has proclaimed a western version of Jesus Christ and the Gospel. Nevertheless, over the centuries Christendom evolved apart from its Torah based Judean Hebraic heritage. The un-compromised, original Nazarene, Torah-based faith was called the WAY. It was taught by Yeshua and the Apostles, and proclaimed throughout Judea and the Mediterranean regions by the power of the Holy Spirit. This faultless, divinely sanctioned faith needs to be restored to the saints today. And Yeshua centric discipleship is the linchpin to this recovery. The Messiah wants His life and truth poured into His people and consecrated discipleship groups led by disciples are the means for doing so effectively. It is the foremost faith commitment truly capable of recovering and restoring doctrinal order, spiritual vigor, ministry power, and love centered unity to the present day conflicted Ecclesia. What’s more, this “lifelong” service initiates the process, so to speak, of individual spiritual transformation for the saints, and enables friendship-fellowships to develop between the sheep--that includes you--and the Good Shepherd, Yeshua. Once again–that spiritual vision, strength and energy, which is sorely missing in today’s needy, doctrinally mixed Christianity, can be effectively restored through the ministry of small, committed messianic discipleship groups–not by the modern way of sermons, auditoriums, power points instruction, conferences, or classroom schedules. These can be supportive, but will never themselves satisfy the blaring need.

Choose for yourself today who you will serve” (Joshua 24:15)

“The body of Messiah today, or the modern American Ecclesia, has been spinning its wheels for 2,000 years. Generation after generation, disciples of Messiah fail to be made. The worldly values, beliefs, distractions, and religions of the nations in which the American body of Messiah currently abides have contributed to the spiritual infertility of each generation, and the true ways of God have not been passed on. The lack of a consistent, unwavering model of unabridged Scripture instruction, with training in righteousness and holiness leaves each new generation to find its own way. And like the generation before, it fails. Disciples are students of the Messiah. They are also called to be personal teachers who model the Father’s Torah based truth for the upcoming generations” [1]

Discipleship is your future. Consider the questions? Do you, reader, want to commit to becoming a bonafide disciple of our Good Shepherd Yeshua? Have you counted the cost? It’s for serious saints. Be fully aware “that the road leading to the Promised Land ‘flowing with milk and honey‘ of necessity runs by way of Mount Sinai flowing with ‘thou shalt’ and ‘thou shalt not.’ “ Thus Apostle John wrote: “The one who keeps His commandments abides in him, and He in him”(1John 5:24). 1B

Disciple, you are deeply loved and have been well equipped. So consider now your calling’s strong conditions:

1. The standard of your discipleship--your new life in Yeshua, is the Torah. See Psalm 119:142

2. The power of your discipleship--is the Holy Spirit. See Acts 1 and 2

3. The High Priest of your discipleship--is the Messiah Yeshua. See Hebrews 4:14-16

4. The outcome of your Messiah-centered discipleship--is overcoming (a) the pride of life, the lusts of the eye and flesh, and (b) works of spiritual darkness. See Revelation 2 and 3.

5. The joy of your discipleship--is experienced by becoming a blessed disciple maker as was your Good Shepherd. Psalm 23; Matthew 28:18-20.

And 6. The destiny of your discipleship--is the resurrection of the righteous and eternal fellowship with your glorified Messiah in the New Jerusalem.

Finally, His Word is for self-sacrificing disciples–-You: “Truly I tell you.Jesus replied, no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the Gospel will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age: homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields-along with persecutions–and in the age to come eternal life. But many who are first will be last, and the last first” (Mark 10:29-31).

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Your host, Hutch Church.

P.S. “For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourself; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast”(Ephesians 2:8-9).

Saints are saved by faith…and that for good works and compliance with the sacred words. So be glad, dear disciple. You are greatly loved, empowered by the Holy Spirit. and chosen to (1) exalt Yeshua, (2) bear much fruit, and (3) succeed in all to which you put your heart and hand. Deuteronomy 28:1-12. So lift up your hands and praise Him now. You have good reasons to do so. Amen.

item.description: Marine Corps and Contemporary Church Juxtaposition: Conclusion
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Welcome to Contender’s Voice on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

“Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful” (1 Corinthians 4:2)

Our straightforward, spiritual examination of the United States Marine Corps and America’s institutional, 21st Century Christian Church is now concluded, and their Reports Cards and final grades are ready for release. Also, a Personal Faith Evaluation exercise is available for all the bold readers who are emotionally prepared to honestly evaluate themselves. Such an effort holds much merit. It is written: “Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves…”( 2 Corinthians 13:5.) Wouldn’t it be wise for everyone who claims Yeshua as Savior and Lord to examine themselves in order to detect and dispel pernicious faults and any hypocrisy hiding deeply within the soul. And secondly, wouldn’t it be spiritually beneficial for all these saints to assess and recalibrate if necessary the Scriptural integrity of the faith that shapes our lives and underscores our national ethos? Yes, of course, on both counts.

Just below is another excellent exhortation, dear friends of Yeshua, that encouraged our contrasting the Marine Corps with the contemporary American Church. It is an exercise by which you and I can greatly benefit individually. Hence, is also written: “For if we would judge ourselves, we would not be judged” (1 Corinthians 11:31) Let’s graft the wisdom of those words into our hearts, free ourselves from hidden spiritual impediments which distort our perception of biblical truth, and go forward by His grace to heightened discipleship maturity. These words clearly encourage believers to do a “deep dive” spiritual assessment of themselves, also of their walk of faith with Yeshua, and discern if their lives and service accurately reflect the teaching of the Word of God. Wouldn’t a heartfelt evaluation of our souls be a beneficial component of our prayer lives? Of course it would! Hence, each believer should be led by the Holy Spirit as he or she learns to fully cooperate with their heavenly Father’s blessed scriptural encouragement. See also 2 Peter 1:10!

Part 1. This blog’s purpose: First, it is to reveal and grade the character of the U. S. Marine Corps. Secondly, it is provided to reveal and grade the character of the westernized, 21st century American Church also. Thirdly, this blog compares the loyalty demonstrated by both entities to the five common principles that are listed below. Fourthly, it is written to help readers discern westernized Christianity’s spiritual and moral shortcomings and encourage the recovery of the biblical standards which characterized the early apostolic, Book of Acts faith. Therefore, Contender’s Voice ministries are prepared with hope for expediting the recover of the lost foundations of the apostolic faith. That would be the apostolic Nazarene faith of the early Ecclesia that was once for all delivered to the saints. It was called the “Way” and it needs to have its abandoned faith foundations restored to Christianity’s messianic community. Our comparing the Corps and the Church will expose the shortcomings of Christendom and thus facilitate its Torah-based restoration.

Five Common Principles under Performance Evaluation.

1. Discipline. Self-sacrifice.

2. Devotion to Duty. Obedience to all specified Standards.

3. Cooperation with Leadership and Teamwork.

4. Loyalty to the corporate Ethos--Trustworthiness and Personal Integrity..

5. Uncompromised Commitment to the Prime Directive

Report Cards for both the Marine Corps and the American Church can be reviewed at Part 2.

Note: Subscribe for free and Audio will be activated.

An assessment of modern Christian faith is wisdom in action for such an exercise reveals the dire need for a spiritual and moral faith reformation today. Westernized Christianity, as a whole, has become socially irrelevant throughout the world’s “first nations.” This cultural phenomenon is well documented. Churches are closing and Mosques are opening throughout Europe, for instance, and America faces the same threat now. Generally speaking, we are a spiritually sub-par religious group composed of folks that want not to hear life-changing teaching but only pleasant and unchallenging messages that keep them feeling “okay.”

Part 2 –- Grades are next!

Heart-felt obedience to Yeshua’s teaching is worship in its most pure form and what’s more, it demonstrates a disciple’s pure love for the Messiah and for one’s neighbor. See Deuteronomy 6:5-8; Leviticus 23; John 4:24.

Learn: Willing conformance to an established company’s standards is the linchpin that actually maintains loyalty to its purpose, supports leadership and operational teamwork, develops and upholds the ethos [character or spirit] of the organization, and helps keep its focus clear of obstructions. In other words, it is the commitment to obedience that makes success and confidence possible among the people involved in every human undertaking. What’s more, obedience requires aligning one’s will with established authority. And it requires faith, humility, self denial, and courage also, especially for both the Marine Corps and the Church of Messiah. Both entities are called to face, confront, and overcome enemies, both physical and spiritual. We are about to discover how loyal the Marines are to their Commandant’s example and common Saints to the Messiah’s example. Thus, we conclude that sincere compliance to authority in our lives is an absolute necessity. So let’s look at the standards and grade our two selected entities’ according to their faithfulness and compliance to these values, and give corresponding grades. Review Deuteronomy 6:4-9; Psalm 1:1-2; Matthew 28:19-20; Romans 1:5 and 16:26-27; for starters.

Standards Table: Performance is rated on a 5 to 1 scale. Thus, loyalty to each value is graded 1 to 5. The final grade will be either A,B,C,D, or F. There has been no bias on my part regarding grades. The assessment is honest though each reader is free to disagree, of course. The numbers and grades are a reflection based on my membership and experience both each organizations.

Modern U.S. Marine Corps as demonstrated by it active duty Marines.

1. Discipline and Self-sacrifice. These values are inculcated immediately upon one’s arrival at Parris Island. Grade 5

2. Devotion to Duty. Obedience. Grade 4.5

3. Full cooperation with Leadership and Teamwork. Grade 5

4. Compliance to the Prime Directives--all General Orders and the U.S. Code of Military Justice. Grade 5

5. Adherence to the stated Mission. Grade 5

Overall Grade: 24.5, which is an A

Modern, westernized, contemporary American Church of today as demonstrated by Proclaimers of Yeshua.

1. Discipline, Discipleship, and Self denial. Grade 2.5

2.Devotion to Duty, i.e., obedience to Yeshua’s Instructions, all that are known, applicable, and doable. Grade 2

3. Respect for Leadership and Teamwork. Yeshua remains your first love. Grade 3

4. Compliance to Yeshua’s prime directive--the two Greatest Commandments: Deuteronomy 6:5-8. Leviticus 1918. Grade 2

5. Adherence to Yeshua’s Great Commission--making disciples who are obedient to the faith. Matthew 28:18-20. Romans 1 and 16. Grade 2.

Overall Grade: 11.5, which is equivalent to a C-.

Part 3. Explanations

A. Comment why the Marine Corps achieved high scores:

Summary: The Marine Corps’ battalions and divisions are unified in their standards, training, and functions. They are loyal to their sworn commitments, exemplify pride, display confidence in teamwork, and zeal for assignments. Further, the Corps’ history reveals that they are willing to risk themselves and sometimes even give their lives in fulfilling the call of duty to preserve the nation’s national and constitutional interests to which they have sworn. Modern Christianity is not unified but, despite its courageous and compassionate but Torahless missions work, remains diversified in their doctrines, traditions, and world view.

B. Comment on why the Institutional Western Church received lower scores:

Summary: Heed what is written, dear saint: “You shall not add to the word that I command you, nor take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your Elohim” (Deuteronomy 4:2). American churches and their denominations, unlike the Marine Corps, are not united or steady in their loyalty to their proven biblical doctrines or to immediate discipleship training. In. fact, most appear to not be disciples of the Good Shepherd but disciples of the world instead. There’s no middle ground, you know. Rather than stand on Scripture alone, Christian ministries are entertaining unjustified inclusions which, contrary to Yahweh’s Torah instructions, have been added to the faith. Such unsanctioned insertions include the New Apostolic Reformation, Christian Nationalism, the Seven Mountain Theology, Rome-centric ecumenism, and assorted misleading doctrines. This coincides with the antichrist, one world religion that is the goal that New World Order advocates are successfully advancing. For instance, the United Arab Emirates has inaugurated the “Abrahamic Family House” which is a worship center that unites a Mosque, a Church, and a Synagogue!

Many Christian beliefs have actually devolved from the apostolic era and have become malformed over time, being distanced from the original pristine Nazarene faith taught by Messiah Yeshua and His apostles. Manifold evangelical Christianity does not position itself on the Torah nor on the complete ministry of the Holy Spirit. The result of this abandonment of pristine apostolic truth is the corruption of the spiritual and moral condition of American culture. We are now overwhelmed by infernal powers and deceptions. This too bears witness to the utter decline of modern Christianity’s doctrinal and spiritual integrity. The weaknesses in denominational faith have been brought about by disobedience to original sacred truth and compliance to false doctrine.

Do you, my dear friend, observe the overt dereliction of duty committed by the saints in knowing but nevertheless not keeping the instruction of the Most High Elohim? I think many, if not most, Christian claimants fall short of the Father’s expectations, but they seem apathetic anyway and preoccupied with their own spiritual pursuits. And therein lies the source of Christendom’s demise. Questions: Do you believe the strong character traits demanded by the Marine Corps -- discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork-- should be raised up and strongly emphasized immediately by church training ministries? Those qualities are entirely Scriptural! Do you believe institutional Catholicism and Protestantism, despite their historic reformation efforts and claims, have wandered far from their original Hebraic heritage and exist well below their divinely given potential now? Answer YES or NO. Middle ground does not exist! And do you think we can recover neglected truth and faith, and see a great Whole Word Revival and the restoration of Yahweh’s Ecclesia, at least for an awakened remnant? I certainly do. Good things are still in reach, beloved overcomer.

Part 4. Now judge yourself, reader. Let the Holy Spirit be your guide as you examine the level of your loyalty to the the standards listed above, and give yourself a grade. Your personal Grade:

Conclusion

Do you, dear reader, considered the evaluations? Have you discerned a spiritual decline, like a plague, that has weakened the Ecclesia of Elohim? If so, is it possible that you might be holding onto subjective judgments, cherished but false doctrines, and even long-standing beliefs that do not align with the truth and ways of the Messiah, our Torah Teacher? If so, would you exchange them for biblical convictions rooted in the unsullied, pure Word of God? Or, are you content living in contradiction to the Holy Scripture and are “okay” about it, as are most church attenders today who proclaim Yeshua as Messiah? A life of service, even self-sacrifice, accompanied by peace and joy is the norm for disciples. Our LORD never instructed us to make converts. No, it is disciples who obey the faith that He wants.

I wrote this article in hope to encourage His saints to ascend to full compliance with His truth and enjoy the intimate, spiritual friendship--fellowship with our ADONAI that is associated with such a glorious commitment. When your time on earth ends, here are the precious words you can expect to hear: “Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few thing; I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your Lord” (Matthew 25:21).

Tamid Kadima--Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom
