item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Welcome to Contender’s Voice on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

“For with God nothing shall be impossible” (Luke 1:37).

Question: Do you believe Yahweh our Elohim has limitless power and the ability to perform what seems impossible, and to act beyond human understanding or capability – even for you personally, dear reader? [1]

Well, here’s a comment for us to consider. Yahweh, our omniscient Creator, is doing something truly great for you, for myself also, and even for all those who follow Messiah Yeshua! He is fulfilling a spiritual need with a prophetically aligned undertaking that is motivated by His agape {unconditional} love, sublime wisdom, and immeasurable power. Be sure of this, however--His restoration work is inspired and led by the Spirit of God–not by a human teacher or a stand-out, mega ministry of some sort. Rather it is the Almighty Himself who is leading believers into a new and probably final reformation, the one that is destined to restore the full Gospel of salvation, foundational Torah truth, the complete ministry of the Holy Spirit, and the full Lordship of Yeshua to the yielded remnant of the western Ecclesia. The testimonies of (1) messianic believers, (2) the lawlessness of our spiritual and secular culture, (3) the growing Torah recovery movement, and (4) the prophetic Scriptures--all bear witness that modernized western Christianity needs an honest evaluation and very likely a thorough recalibration of its theology, faith practices and traditions. Contrasting the Marine Corps and Church’s faithfulness to their commitments is unusual but can prove to be an effective means of exposing the Ecclesia’s shortcomings and thereby where doctrinal recoveries based on the standards of the original, apostolic Nazarene faith are needed.

Part 1

Today’s backslidden, morally depleted American culture is the lamentable product of Torahless institutional Christianity. A “whole truth reclamation" that infuses a Spirit empowered, biblical revival--for which many are praying, is the fundamental need for the nation’s conflicted, traditional faith. And, as stated earlier, our compassionate Father in heaven is responding to the shortfall. We are witnessing a Spirit-led restoration of pure biblical truth rising in accordance with what is written: “Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made low, uneven ground shall become level, and the rough places a plain. And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together, for the mouth of the LORD has spoken” (Isaiah 40:1-31). By the grace of God such a Spirit and Truth restoration is mounting already. For instance, the exiled Ten Tribe prodigals are returning--as prophesied, to the Father’s house, His instructions for life and worship, and to the older brother, Judah. See: Hosea 1, 3; Amos 9:9; Ezekiel 37; Jeremiah 3:11-18 and chapter 3; Isaiah 11:11-14; Luke 15:11-32, and 1 Peter 2:10 for starters.

Part 2

Yahweh wants the people who claim Him as Savior and Lord to loose themselves from errant, misleading denominational doctrines and practices, commit as His set-apart disciples, and follow His unmixed, pure instructions! Believers are not saved by obeying His Law…we are saved and born-again for obeying it. Thus, messianic Christians are being summoned by the Holy Spirit to recover and restore the same faith that Messiah Yeshua modeled, taught His apostles, and who then passed it along to the Jewish disciples, and even Gentile converts. Being immersed in westernized, doctrinally diverse Christianity is not supported by Scripture. It’s true that our nation's foremost religion has indeed made significant contributions to human progress throughout the world. But it has also drifted far from abiding with its original apostolic Nazarene moorings of spiritual power, Hebraic foundations, proclaiming the Torah-Gospel in the power of the Spirit and heralding the Kingdom of God, His righteousness, and the necessity of discipleship. Hence, modern, spiritually vitiated faith will eventually be left behind by zealous disciples who want an intimate fellowship with King Yeshua and all His Words. These ardent contenders can be expected to gravitate to groups and assemblies that have restored the Torah’s foundations of faith, welcomed the unabridged ministry of the Holy Spirit, and promoted the requirement of discipleship under the tutelage of the Messiah Yeshua. No excuses. No compromising. Matthew 28:16-20.

Yes, the call of recovery pertains to engrafted Israelites today. You and I, even all the saints of the Most High Elohim, are now identified by the national origin of our faith--Israel. That identity refers to every Spirit-born believer, everyone of whom the Almighty has equipped for bible-endorsed success and witness. Romans 11; 1 Peter 2:9. Thus it is written to you and to me…to all of us: “Therefore tell the people; this is what the Almighty says: Return to Me” (Zechariah 1:3). When believers finally get around to following all His instructions–that is, all of the Bible's Torah-rooted instructions we know and can follow, instead of cherry-picking only the laws we like, or can bend, or re-invent – then our lives will prosper and demonic power will fade to the background and dissipate. And we will be recognized as Savior’s “overcomers.” See Revelation 2-3.

Part 3

“What can the righteous do when the foundations [Torah based truth] are destroyed [broken and rejected]” (Psalm 11:3)?

Blessed friends, a Torah recovery is a must !

America has become a conflicted nation whose populace at large is confused, drawn to preferences but lacking in strong spiritual and moral convictions. Our traditional religious standards, that actually serve as cultural guardians and social chaperons so to speak, have been rejected. Our country’s spiritual and moral relapse has shaped its weakened character, the ghastly image of spiritually compromised, Torah-rejecting, Spirit resisting Christianity. Hence, our entire culture has become (1) subject to lawlessness–our foremost plague, (2) beguiled while living under a demonic spell, and (3) governed by a reprobate federal government, far-spread leftist bureaucracies, and unholy, parasitic foreign influences.

The manifold corruptions our country’s spiritual and secular institutions have suffered are inculpatory evidence of our desperate need for restoring the ancient foundations of our faith. Our hope? Yahweh is still alive and on His throne of grace. He remains faithful and compassionate, and will fulfill His prophetic Word for those who seek Him with their whole heart.. His promise remains: “Return to me {with heartfelt repentance} and I will return to you” (Malachi 3:7).

So, will our juxtaposition of military recruits and religious Christians raise the idea that converts to Messiah Yeshua would do well by attending small discipleship groups and, in unity, begin orienting their lives around Yeshua's commandments and calendar.

Is a zealous bride--probably a remnant of believers, beginning to prepare herself for her King’s return? We have an example of religious zeal based upon truth to inspire us and emulate. Remember who was called to announce the appearance of the Savior to Israel? It was John the Baptist of the strict Essene community of faith. These were serious religious people who were waiting for the advent of the Messiah. Shouldn’t today’s Spirit-born believers be even more devoted to walking out their faith? Yes! Take time and go to Matthew 11:11 for confirmation. Anyway, a step-by-step program would help...something challenging that would boost zeal and commitment, embrace genuine discipleship, inspire the study of the Torah, lead saints to be baptized with the Holy Spirit, honor the Sabbath and Moadim, and become familiar with other hebraic customs followed by the Messiah. Returning to un-reformed westernized, modern Christian faith is not enough for charging converts and sustaining a long-term, prophetic revival.

Part 4

We can’t love the kingdoms of this dark world and Yeshua’s Kingdom at the same time, brethren. It’s one or the other. Compromise, a spiritual contaminant and an enemy of salvation faith, is found in abundance along the Broad Road leading to destruction in the Lake of Fire. A very frightening prospect. In any case, such a promotion to ascend in spiritual maturity would carry a welcoming Holy Spirit vibe, to use the parlance of the seventies, and awaken a holy ambition in many converts. When the disciples of old were called by Yeshua to follow Him they were immediately stirred, and at once responded and gave up their lives and silly “bucket lists” to travel with Yeshua and imbibe their divine Rabbi’s teaching and ways of life and ministry. Their journey of faith could be called a mobile boot camp, one might say. So what is it going to be, readers--our personal plans or His prophetic plans?

The Messiah declares clearly: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me {clearly--submit to my commandments}” (Matthew 16:24-27; brackets added by C.V.). For greater clarity, I present to you the Greek word for the English word, “follow.” It is hepomai. The Greek word means to obey. Period. Further, re-read John 3:36. It uses the word believe which can be also translated as obey.

1. AI Overview

Part 5

The sacred Scriptures are straightforward. Hence, we who follow the Messiah are ordered, not asked or cajoled, but ordered to submit to the Messiah’s personal lordship, instructions, and sanctified lifestyle. It is written: “You shall follow My rules and keep My statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God” (Leviticus 18:4-5). See also Luke 11:28; John 14:15; etc. Do you know anyone who follows that instruction? Yet, that lifestyle is where the Holy Spirit is leading Yeshua’s sheep; the ones who listen to the Master’s voice. The act of compliance to His stated will sets the saints apart from the world and is also a strong expression of faith and love. Only there do we find our spiritual strength and elevated prophetic vision. Yes, submission is an act of faith and love that works for our welfare and His glory. Keep in mind, He is Adonai–the eternal One existing with divine authority over all creation! Shouldn’t we who claim Him as our King of Glory turn around and start following Him by living in full compliance with His Scriptural truth? Should we stop partial, even lukewarm observance of sacred truth and start honoring that which (1) we have learned or have at least have heard, (2) is applicable to our lives, (3) is doable--and (4) go forward from that point with heartfelt effort. To stall is not an option. Rather, let us go forward into full freedom, abiding joy, transformation and enlightenment of soul, victory over sin and demonic oppression, prophetic vision, and intimate friendship-fellowship with the Messiah. Such is our assigned and blessed portion, my friends!

Actually, honoring this commitment, which should be made at the point of one’s salvation, necessitates a complete identification with the life and righteous standards of Yeshua. In other words, disciples are expected to share the way, the truth, and the life of their Redeemer…and take these as their own, so to speak. And we should seek to grow into His powerful ministry as well. Indeed, it is written: “For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power” (1Corinthians 4:20). In other words, the Kingdom of God, over which Yeshua is the Sovereign, is demonstrated through action and power, not just with ongoing words or teachings. By the way…have you been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit? Every disciple should be, of course. Read Acts 1 and 2 again. Do you believe what occurred then is for you today? Don’t let secessionist teaching discourage you. Ask Yeshua to baptize you with His Spirit right now! He is faithful.

Part 6

Again, let’s make progress toward discovery by comparing (1) the loyalty of the Marine Corp to its fundamental standards with (2) the loyalty of the westernized American Church to its fundamental standards. Loyal adherence of each of these two entites to the following five common standards–expectations, will be evaluated and graded.

(1) Discipline; Self-denial. (2) Devotion to Duty; Obedience to all official Orders/Comments. (3) Respect for Leadership and Unified Teamwork. (4) Compliance to a Prime Directive. (5) Mission Applications and Effectiveness.

Reason for Being

Grades for loyalty to the five virtues of each of our two subjects will be posted in the next blog. Keep in mind as you read--Contender’s Voice vigorously promotes and contributes to the growing restoration of the original Torah-based, apostolic faith taught by Yeshua, proclaimed with power by his Apostles, and faithfully practiced by the early Judean disciples. This historic biblical truth recovery, though it continues to grow, must nevertheless be continually revived by consistently enlightening the saints who are not fully aware or convinced of their (1) doctrinal deficiencies, (2) lack of spiritual power, (3) Israelite identity and heritage, (4) prophetic purpose, and the (5) transformative power inherent in the blessed faith foundations of the apostolic New Covenant Faith called the Way. Its dynamic faith and historical works are recorded in the Book of Acts, as mentioned earlier. Our comparison between the Corps and the Church will expose the spiritual profile of the modern westernized American Church of this hour. This is our goal--to accurately diagnose the weaknesses and provide the needed restoration remedy.

Catholic and Protestant Christendom form a worldwide eclectic colossus of the Christian religion with its varied doctrines and practices that have devolved from the original, post-resurrection, Torah-based faith of the Book of Acts. And it has become apparent that a large Scriptural gap separates the former uncompromised faith from our popular, institutional, manifold latter-day American faith that commonly preaches a social gospel. Many church goers are becoming unhappy to sit under that kind of ministry, dear reader. Prophetic Newswatch stated recently that 15,000 American churches are expected to be closed during the year 2025. [1] Sincere Church goers want spiritual meat, not milk, coming from their pulpits. Anyway let’s do something really unexpected, and explore the extent of this division and the spiritual debilitations it has caused. Then attend to the reformation repairs that are needed. How do we do that? I repeat--it is by comparing the westernized American Church with the U.S. Marine Corps. Is such a procedure warranted? Yes! Did you know that comparing things–their similarities and differences, their strengths and weaknesses--can be a powerful and effective method of evaluation and grading people or organizations? Hence, this is our current blog's methodology.

1. 10/7

Part 7

A faith priority of genuine whole truth people is holiness, which references consecration to Messiah Yeshua and His words. This comes from conformance to divine, spiritual truth. It is written: “Be ye holy for I am holy” (Leviticus 11:45, 19:2; 20:7; 1 Peter 1:16). But as mentioned, the western Ecclesia as a whole has fallen away from pure Scripture realities to imbibe false teaching and unholy behavior, i.e.--lawlessness. Yet every saint is called to live a spiritually, ritually, and morally pure life, and be sanctified. That means being set apart from worldly influences and persuasions. But holiness is not achieved solely, so to speak, by self effort but through faith in Messiah Yeshua and dependance upon the Holy Spirit. Are you prepared to set yourself apart from the world’s attractions, valued readers?

Once a spiritual shortfall is evaluated and made apparent to our discerning readers, the exciting prospect of undertaking a new and challenging scripture based, truth journey opens. It is a trek that is solidly based upon the legitimacy of the Torah, the full ministry of the Holy Spirit, and devotion to Yeshua. This journey is very inviting. It appeals to many highly motivated believers. These zealous followers of Yeshua desire to regain footing on the Narrow Road, go forward on “new spiritual ground” in their faith adventure, and regain a more intimate spiritual level of genuine holiness and friendship-fellowship with Messiah Yeshua. A greater prophetic endtime vision for a more timely and relevant ministry will emerge also.

This was the goal of the early Nazarene saints who delighted in living and worshipping in full compliance with the Father’s eternal holy truth. Therefore, the intention of Contender’s Voice is to promote and witness the fulfillment of the following three restoration goals: First, to experience a broad based, enduring whole-truth revival; secondly, to witness the full restoration of the Holy Spirit’s uncompromised ministry and the Torah-centric truth to a large remnant of the Ecclesia; thirdly, to make true disciples of Yeshua “for the obedience of the faith.” Romans 1 and 16. Without following His ways and honoring His words there is no discipleship.

Part 8

At this time however American Christianity has become tailored by false teachers and reprobate dreamers, and remains, at least for now, under demonic persuasions to comfort people in their errors, but not to warn and challenge them about holiness and abiding on the Narrow Road to eternal life. Let us understand that this road is trod by only a few saints–i.e., a scanty amount of believers. The rest, the “many,” are on the Broad Road leading to the Mark of the Beast and damnation. There’s no middle ground…not for them, or us. None at all. Worldly believers of casual faith, and those given over to reprobate mindsets, do not grasp the seriousness of His words and therefore have not discerned or discovered the Narrow Gate. Few there are that find it. By the way--the word “few” does mean “a scanty amount!” See Matthew 7:13-14; 28:19-20; Romans 1:5 and 16:26, and John 14:15. Yeshua does not mince words or exaggerate. His warnings are given by grace and by hearing them we can benefit greatly!

The restoration vision mentioned earlier can become a reality, but only by evaluating western Christianity’s weaknesses and strengths, and then correcting the deficiencies riff in America’s westernized Christianity. Believers are summoned to be contenders for biblical truth. We have a responsibility to proclaim and model the complete Gospel of the Kingdom, and make disciples for the Messiah and committed followers of His sacred teaching. Loyalty to standards can be more easily determined by comparing the earthly performances of our two selected groups.

Again, Contender’s Voice will juxtapose, or compare, the loyalty of modern America’s Christian faith to its espoused virtues with the loyalty of the U.S. Marine Corps to its proclaimed virtues. We list once more the values that will be assessed. We will gauge the loyalty of both entities to faithfully demonstrate (1) personal discipline and self-sacrifice, (2) devotion to duty; and teamwork (3) respect for established authority; leadership (4) commitment to the prime directive, and (5) compliance with the assigned mission. Use these for yourself also!

We do the actual grading but you can also decide for yourself what grades you think should be given and which entity has displayed the greatest loyalty to its fundamental commitments. In any case, I will meet you there!

Tamid Kadima–Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom

Remember readers:Take time to pray for Jerusalem and Israel, Judah and the restoration of Torah faith to the exiled tribes of the House of Israel. And please intercede for the many persecuted Christians living in hostile nations. See: Deuteronomy 33:13-17; Psalms 122:6; 1 Kings 11, 12; 2 Kings 17; 25; Ezekiel 37; Hosea 1 and 3, Amos 9:9; Jeremiah chapter 3:11-18; and chapter 31; Isaiah 11:11-14

item.description: Lawlessness has long reigned over America. The nation is now awakening.
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contender’s Voice Commentary on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

(Subscribe to get Audio)

For although they knew God, they did not honor Him as God nor give thanks…therefore God gave them over in the lusts of their hearts to impurity…for they exchanged the truth of God for a lie and worshiped and served the creature rather than the creator… for this reason God gave them over to degrading passions…and although they knew the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, they not only do the same, but also give hearty approval to those who practice the same” (from Romans 1: 21-31 NASB).

Haughty Reprobates Cheered the Assassination. Teachers and professors of America’s youth were prominent among them.

Last week Charley Kirk, the notable conservative political campaigner and vocal promoter of Judeo-Christian values, was assassinated at Utah Valley University. Kirk was outdoors debating the assembled students when he was murdered by a radicalized leftist shooter. Charley Kirk was a devoted family man, a committed Christian, a bold promoter of the Ten Commandments, and a vocal supporter of the unabolished original Sabbath. It is positioned as the fourth commandment among the other nine. Read its instructions in Genesis 2:2-3 and Exodus 20:8. The effort may enlighten some of our evangelical readers. In any case, while Charlie’s death has been roundly cheered by morbid detractors, he will be missed by a discerning and appreciative multitude, and emulated as well.

As a matter of fact, today’s maturing Christian believers actually have a modern and inspirational example of discipleship to imitate, one that was exhibited by this man’s adult life. He regularly visited colleges and universities across the nation where he would challenge the younger generation of mostly propagandized students by debating them over leftist politics and the woke values that pollute moral societies. Charlie Kirk faithfully carried the burden of biblical truth and constitutional ideology into hostile environments, and as he did so Charlie expected to be confronted by volatile resistance and insults from assembled listeners. Nevertheless, before his death, Charlie’s patriotic conservative message and biblical values were becoming accepted by students as he proved himself to be an able and honorable man. He contended for a national faith restoration, a vision founded upon the Scriptures that could grow to unify the nation's increasingly balkanized, conflicted citizenry. He was directing listeners to the narrow road espoused by Yeshua.

The demonized reprobate, who is probably a beguiled pawn of institutional antichrist cabals and their rulers, committed the heinous act that ended Charlie’s life on earth. Thus, despite the varied influences that may have shaped the despised criminal’s life, he has become the new poster-child of Antifa’s marxist left. What a shameful identity. In Hebrew the word for despised is “bazah”. It means to be worthless or repugnant. And it is the infernally inspired rhetoric and antichrist, marxist ideology that has come to characterize America’s spiritual and moral character that continually gives rise to (a) the psychotic derelicts and (b) the demonized mentality that incessantly instigates lawlessness, spawns and spreads crimes of violence, and instigates a civil war.

Let’s be honest. America needs deliverance from the satanic spell it wallows under.

“For our struggle is not against flesh and blood [people], but against the rulers, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in [of] the heavenly realms” (see Ephesians 6:10-18).

The brazen “in your face” public killing of a fundamentally honorable political activist, a rising leader and brave proclaimer of the Gospel to the needful youth of our marxist oriented colleges and universities, was crafted by evil spirits conjured up by the occultic manipulations of godless, plotting humans whose condemnation was written about long ago. See Jude. Charley Kirk’s premeditated murder deeply saddened many people, both of national and international origin, who had been favorably impacted by his prophetic world view. Yet, the accompanying mix of widespread grief and righteous anger among the populace caused by the brutal crime has appeared to kindle a revolutionary fire also. In other words, a dynamic zeal has been birthed in the hearts of many lawful, God-fearing people–i.e., an earnest fervor for recovering the foundations of biblical faith that are entirely suitable for energizing a modern day, beneficial continuation of the uncompleted Lutheran reformation. What do you think, blessed reader?

This fervent drive is capable of galvanizing prayer and repentance leading to a greatly needed restoration movement of law-and-order nationwide. Further, should such a motivated collective endure it could energize a national uprising and a concurrent spiritual awakening that would lead to (1) completely exposing, discrediting, and souring leftist influences and revolutionary ideologies, (2) dispel the dark spiritual components and the unseen demonic forces–inhabitants of the dark spirit realm, which control people, undergird and energize the corruption of our nation’s secular and spiritual institutions, thus producing lawlessness, and (3) return to and restore the essential biblical fundamentals of uncompromised, “whole truth” biblical faith. Such a spiritual awakening could re-establish for America the fundamental faith principles upon which our nation and its unique ethos were founded and developed.

“Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people” (Proverbs 14:34).

Charley Kirk was an ardent and admired forerunner for the recovery of Scriptural righteousness founded upon the exaltation of Messiah Yeshua and His teaching. He was a good man with a solid vision, and though missed by many admirers, he will remain an American icon and an enduring example of faith, hope,and love for a younger, rising generation to emulate. In fact, his assassination could become the “turning point” for this nation, Yeshua’s Ecclesia–His Called Out Assembly, and even for you and me. So, what point does this inhumane, lamentable occurrence, the most recent violent murder of many, make clear? It clearly trumpets the fact that without a great spiritual awakening and concomitant revival, such oppressions as (a) moral depravity, (b) spiritual and secular lawlessness, (c) eventual persecution of Christians, (d) institutional mayhem, digitized healthcare with lots of mRNA vaccines, and (d) transhumanist rooted, AI oversight will surely become the foremost plagues of our backsliding, crumbling nation.

Chat Control 2.0 Surveillance and Censorship, no longer the Scriptures, cast a lengthening shadow.

Again, the spiritually and doctrinally substandard Ecclesia (Church)--that’s us, needs an extraordinary “truth revival,” one that is Yeshua-centric, Torah-based, powered by the full ministry of the Holy Spirit, and a base of genuine discipleship and the Great Commission ministry. The “spiritual life force” that is needed to flow into and inundate our country will accompany such a renewal. However the compromised, western Church system of this hour has not been able to sustain such a “truth revival” or remain charged with spiritual power, or develop the critical salt and light forces spoken of by Yeshua in Matthew 5:13-16.

Repentance, prayer, and heartfelt conformance to the Yeshua’s holy instructions which are revealed and reiterated throughout the Bible, starting with the Torah and running through Revelation. Such a commitment would:

(1) unite us close fellowship with our Elohim,

(2) vitiate the power of evil and break demonic strongholds,

(3) lead to and sustain spiritual enlightenment and endtimes prophetic vision,

(4) develop a strengthened Ecclesia to bear much fruit,

(5) bring on a faith renewal, raise up moral prosperity, and

(6) stabilize a truth foundation upon which to rebuild our lives and culture.

The restoration of biblical truth is possible with the help of YHWH, our Elohim. It is the only means of dispelling the dark spiritual powers that undergird and drive sinfulness, cultural decay, and secular lawlessness. Brethren, it’s time to contend for, recover, and guard the truth once delivered to the saints. Read Jude 1 for clarity. And remember what is also written: “And we know that God causes all things [even very difficult circumstances and challenges] to work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose” ((Romans 8:28). By His grace messianic believers are becoming involved in a Torah truth restoration that is underway and growing.

The promise pertains to you, to me, and to any repentant people. We can wallow in a world controlled by satanic overlords and AI Singularity, or take the messiah’s word to heart. “Seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness…” and experience the prosperity of your soul as you trek the narrow path leading to a new heaven and earth. See Matthew 6:33. With that in mind, fulfill your call, blessed readers. Commit to daily personal prayer, restore righteous standards, move onto the narrow path, live in holiness as a true disciple of Yeshua our High Priest, and take back the spiritual ground that we have handed over to the enemy of our souls. Rather, give all your “life ground” to Him and take your blessed place as a vocal contender for blessed truth–-as was Charlie Kirk.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. .

item.title: Contender's Voice - Part Two
item.description: Weighing the modern American Church and the U.S. Marine Corps on the Scales.
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contender's Voice - Part Two on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

(Audio available to subscribers)

“Return to Me and I will return to you, says the Lord of hosts” (Malachi 3:7)

Purpose: To compare and grade the true-to-life quality of the discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork found in each of these two historic companies.

Our Goal: To make plain the foremost need of today’s common saints.

I have a question to lay before you, brethren. It’s one that calls for a thoughtful and direct answer; not for beating around the bush. In fact, a little contemplation might sharpen your focus on our topic. Anyway, here it is: Does the spiritual ministry of today’s westernized Christian Church, as a whole, compare favorably with that of the original, apostolic Nazarene faith called the Way? You’ve read about this biblical faith in the Book of Acts. Remember, that was the first and only pristine New Testament faith “once for all handed down to the saints” and endorsed by Yeshua Himself. But it's missing today! In any case, “the Way” was Torah-centric, taught and modeled by the Apostles, followed diligently by Spirit-filled Jewish believers, was accompanied by miracles, testified to the validity of the Gospel, bore witness to the supernatural power of the Kingdom of God, and affirmed the resurrection of Yeshua our Messiah. See 1 Thessalonians 1:5; Jude 1:3. So, does the westernized American Church of this hour compare favorably with the authentic Called Out Assembly of the early Nazarene disciples? You can choose Yes or No for now. But our contrast between the westernized American Church and the U.S. Marine Corps will soon provide a clear answer.

Subscribe for free to get the audio.

Central Truth

Recruits must be made into fully trained Marines. Likewise, Converts of Yeshua must be made into fully equipped, narrow road disciples. I am happy to report that some progress is now being made toward satisfying this necessity of the modern Church. At this time, inspired messianic Christians are becoming genuine students of Yeshua their Teacher. And they are devoting themselves to His Torah-based instructions and to becoming loyal adherents to their Master’s Words--all that they learn. These fledgling disciples do not remain bonded to the mixed and varied doctrines of hundreds of denominational fathers, but they depart from them to make their spiritual aliyah to their blessed hebraic heritage. The Narrow Road is their chosen path, and the only one leading to the resurrection of the righteous and eternal life. The other pathway, of course, is the Broad Road that leads its travelers to condemnation, Hell, and eventually the Lake of Fire. Matthew 5:30; Mark 9:48; Luke 16:23; Revelation 19:20; 20:10, 14 and 15; 21:8. Keep in mind--Hell and the Lake of Fire are not symbols or metaphors. They are established realities. Yeshua referred to Hell more than He spoke of heaven, and warned people about these places and the many careless souls that will end up in them! He also spoke of Hell and outer darkness more often than anyone else in the Bible. Do not dismiss His warnings. Yeshua did not mince words. His teaching is beyond equivocation!

Obedience to religious dogma does not save anyone. We are saved only by faith in Yeshua the Son and His atoning blood. However, obedience to Yahweh’s sacred Torah instructions–which are reiterated in our Messiah’s New Testament teachings, is a true expression of salvation faith. Further, obedience–a concept shunned by most saints today, demonstrates love for God and for one’s neighbor. It also keeps us on the narrow road that leads to eternal life, transforms the soul, and develops friendship-fellowship with our Good Shepherd. What’s more, obedience opens heaven’s door to a great flow of blessing and vanquishes demonic strongholds as well.

Back to the Weigh In

This much is obvious. The Marine Corps record is open to a straight forward examination. Scrutinizing America’s westernized Church however requires a slightly closer look. The testimonies of (1) messianic believers, (2) the lawlessness of our spiritual and secular culture, (3) the growing Torah recovery movement, and (4) the prophetic Scriptures--all reveal modernized, institutional Christianity needs an honest evaluation and very likely a recalibration of its ecclectic theology and worldly faith practices and traditions.

Our culture has not been favored at all by America’s worldly institutional Christianity which, generally speaking, continues to suffer from spiritual and doctrinal alterations. That something is dreadfully wrong is evident. But by the grace of God a spiritual restoration movement is upwelling, as C.V. has reported. What we will discover in our three-part blog, I think, are valid reasons for this restoration occurring. For instance, the exiled Ten Tribe prodigals are returning--as prophesied, to the Father’s house, His instructions for life and worship, and to the older brother, Judah. See: Hosea 1, 3; Amos 9:9; Ezekiel 37; Jeremiah 3:11-18 and chapter 3; Isaiah 11:11-14; Luke 15:11-32, and 1 Peter 2:10 for starters.

Yahweh wants His people who claim Him as Savior and Lord to loose themselves from errant denominational doctrines and practices to follow His unmixed, pure instructions! Thus, messianic Christians are being summoned by the Holy Spirit to recover and restore the same faith that Messiah Yeshua modeled, taught His apostles, and who then passed it along to the Jewish disciples, and even Gentile converts. Yes, that call of recovery pertains to engrafted Israelites today. You and I, saints of the Most High Elohim, are first identified by the nation of our faith. That refers to every Spirit-born believer. Romans 11; 1 Peter 2:9. Thus it is written to you and to me…to all of us: “Therefore tell the people; this is what the Almighty says: Return to Me” (Zechariah 1:3). When believers finally get around to following His all instructions instead of cherry-picking only the laws they like or invent, their lives will prosper and demonic power will fade to the background!

Will our juxtaposition of military recruits and religious converts ignite an idea that converts to Messiah Yeshua would do well by attending some sort of tailored Bible Boot Camp? Do you, blessed reader, remember who was called to announce the appearance of the Savior to Israel? It was John the Baptist of the strict Essene community of faith. These were serious religious people who were waiting for the advent of the Messiah. Shouldn’t today’s Spirit-born believers be even more devoted to walking out their faith too? Yes! Perhaps a step-by-step program would help...something that would boost zeal and commitment, embrace genuine discipleship, inspire the study of the Torah, lead saints to be baptized with the Holy Spirit, honor the Sabbath and Moadim, and become familiar with other hebraic associations. We can’t love the world and His Kingdom at the same time, brethren. It’s one or the other. Compromise, a spiritual contaminant, is found in abundance along the Broad Road leading to destruction. In any case, such a promotion to ascend in spiritual maturity could carry a welcoming vibe, to use the parlance of the seventies, and awaken a holy ambition in many converts. When the disciples of old were called they were immediately stirred, and at once gave up their lives and silly “bucket lists” to travel with Yeshua and imbibe their divine Rabbi’s teaching and ways of life and ministry. Their journey of faith could be called a mobile boot camp, one might say. So what is it going to be, readers--our personal plans or His prophetic plans? What does your life reveal at this time?

Didn’t the Messiah say, “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me [clearly--submit to my commandments]” (Matthew 16:24-27; brackets added by C.V.). For greater clarity, I present to you the Greek word for the English word, “follow.” It is hepomai. The Greek word means to obey. Further, re-read John 3:36. It uses the word believe which can be also translated as obey.

The sacred Scriptures are straightforward. We who follow the Messiah are ordered, not asked or cajoled, but ordered to submit to the Messiah’s personal lordship and sanctified lifestyle. It is for our welfare and His glory. He is Adonai–the eternal One with divine authority! Shouldn’t we who claim His as Lord turn around and start following Him now, and not later? We start by living in compliance with the truth (1) we know or have heard, (2) is applicable, and (3) doable--and go forward from that point. Or we stall!

Hence, honoring this commitment, which should be made at the point of one’s salvation, necessitates a complete identification with the life and righteous standards of Yeshua. In other words, disciples are expected to share the way, the truth, and the life of their Redeemer…and take these as their own, so to speak…and His powerful ministry also. Indeed, it is written: “For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power” (1Corinthians 4:20). In other words, the Kingdom of God, over which Yeshua is the Sovereign, is demonstrated through action and power, not just ongoing words or teachings. By the way…have you been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit? Every disciple should be, of course. Read Acts 1 and 2 again. Do you believe what occurred then is for you today?

Going Forward to the Comparison

Let’s make progress toward actually comparing the imposed but remarkable standards of the Marine Corp with those of the westernized American Church. Loyal adherence of each subject to the following five common standards will be evaluated and graded: (1) Discipline; Self-denial. (2) Devotion to Duty; Obedience to all official Orders. (3) Respect for Leadership and Unified Teamwork (4) Compliance to a Prime Directive (5) Mission Applications and Effectiveness.

Grades for loyalty to the five virtues of each of our two subjects will be posted in Part 3--which is next. Keep in mind as you read--Contender’s Voice vigorously promotes and contributes to the growing restoration of the original Torah-based, apostolic faith taught by Yeshua, proclaimed with power by his Apostles, and faithfully practiced by the early Judean disciples. This historic biblical truth recovery, though it continues to grow, must nevertheless be continually revived by consistently presenting to the saints who are not fully aware of their spiritual identity and heritage, prophetic purpose, and the transformative power inherent in the blessed faith foundations of the apostolic New Covenant Faith called the Way. Its dynamic doctrines and historical works are recorded in the Book of Acts, as mentioned earlier. Our comparison will reveal, and you will better perceive, the spiritual profile of the modern westernized American Church of this hour. It is a national colossus of varied doctrines and practices that devolved far from the original, post-resurrection faith of the Book of Acts. And it is thus apparent that a large Scriptural gap separates the former uncompromised faith from our popular and relaxed, institutional, manifold latter-day American faith. So let’s do something really unexpected, and explore the extent of this division and the spiritual debilitations it has caused, and the repairs that are needed. How do we do that? I repeat--it is by comparing the westernized American Church with the U.S. Marine Corps. Is such a procedure warranted? Yes! Did you know that comparing things–their similarities and differences, their strengths and weaknesses--can be a powerful and effective method of evaluation and grading people or organizations? Hence, this is our current blog's methodology.

Goal

Once this spiritual shortfall is evaluated and made apparent to our discerning readers, the exciting prospect of undertaking a new and challenging scripture based, truth journey that is solidly based upon the legitimacy of the Torah and the full ministry of the Holy Spirit, becomes very inviting. This appeals to many highly motivated believers. These zealous followers of Yeshua desire to regain footing on the Narrow Road, go forward on “new spiritual ground” in their faith journey, and regain a more intimate spiritual level of genuine holiness and friendship-fellowship with Messiah Yeshua and greater prophetic, endtime vision.

This was the goal of the early Nazarene saints who delighted by living and worshipping in full accordance with the Master’s holy truth. Therefore, the intention of Contender’s Voice is to promote and witness the fulfillment of the following three goals: First, to experience a broad based, enduring whole-truth revival; secondly, to witness the full restoration of the Holy Spirit’s uncompromised ministry and the Torah-centric truth to a large remnant of the Ecclesia; thirdly, to make true disciples “for the obedience of the faith.” At this point however, American Christianity, in great measure, has been tailored to comfort people, not to warn and challenge them about holiness and abiding on the Narrow Road. Let us understand–this road is trod by only a few saints–i.e., a scanty amount of believers. The rest, the “many,” are on the Broad Road leading to the Mark of the Beast and damnation. There’s no middle ground…not for them, or us. Worldly believers of casual faith, and those given over to reprobate mindsets, do not grasp the seriousness of His words and therefore have not discerned or discovered the Narrow Gate. Few there are that find it. By the way--the word “few” does mean “a scanty amount!” See Matthew 7:13-14; 28:19-20; Romans 1:5 and 16:26, and John 14:15. Yeshua does not exaggerate.

The three-part vision mentioned above can become a reality only by evaluating, assessing weakness and strength, and then overhauling, so to speak, the deficient spiritual condition of America’s westernized Christianity. It likely will be only a remnant that responds. Nevertheless we have a responsibility to proclaim and model the complete Gospel of the Kingdom, and make disciples--true students and consecrated lovers of the Messiah and His teaching.

Loyalty to standards can be determined by comparing the earthly performances of our two selected groups.

Let’s continue now: Contender’s Voice will juxtapose, or compare, the loyalty of modern America’s Christian faith to its espoused virtues with the loyalty of the U.S. Marine Corps to its proclaimed virtues. We repeat the values that will be assessed. The quality of both entities include (1) personal discipline and self-sacrifice, (2) devotion to duty; and teamwork (3) respect for established authority; leadership (4) commitment to the prime directive, and (5) compliance with the assigned mission..

Please stay with me, dear readers. We do the actual grading NEXT...in Part 3. And you can also decide for yourself what grades you think should be given. In any case, I will meet you there!

Tamid Kadima–Always Forward.Hutch Church. Shalom

item.title: Contender’s Voice
item.description: Welcome to our Faith Restoration Update --Part 1
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contender’s Voice on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Dear follower of Yeshua--the following post examines the profile of westernized Christianity. It warrants our attention and a decision on the part of the readers, so you are encouraged to pay attention. Also, Contender’s Voice encourages every visitor and regular reader to prayerfully compare our presentation with New Testament history and the whole Word of God. And then make up their own minds concerning its accuracy and merit for personal application. Thank you, Hutch Church.

A Unique Post

This particular blog has a purpose. First, it is fashioned to encourage the existing Whole Truth Awakening that is occurring today among spiritually hungry, Spirit-led followers of Messiah Yeshua. Secondly, the article is intended to promote and contribute to the growing restoration of the original Torah-based, apostolic faith taught by Yeshua, proclaimed with power by his Apostles, and faithfully practiced by the early Judean disciples. This historic, biblical truth recovery must be continually revived by consistently presenting to unaware saints the origin, purpose, and transformative power inherent in the original faith foundations of the apostolic New Covenant Faith–called the Way. Its dynamic doctrines and historical works are recorded in the Book of Acts. The modern, westernized American Church of this hour–a varied, national colossus, resides far from the original, post-resurrection faith of the Book of Acts. And it is apparent that a large Scriptural gap separates the former faith from our popular and somewhat relaxed latter-day American faith. So let’s do something really unexpected, and explore the extent of this division, the spiritual debilitations it has caused, and the repairs that are needed. How do we do that? By comparing the westernized American Church with the U.S. Marine Corps regarding their adherence to their particular standards. Please understand--the contrasting of profiles is not a contest at all. Neither is it an attempt to glorify one corporate entity over another. Let me be clear--prejudice, competition and vainglory have no place in our juxtaposition exercise. However, honest exposure and analysis leading to the benefit of one or the other does. So, is such a procedure warranted? Yes! Did you know that comparing things–contrast their similarities and differences, their strengths and weaknesses--can be a powerful and effective method of evaluation and grading the loyalty of people or organizations to their specific values? Hence, this is our current blog's methodology.

Our two entities, or subjects–the western American Church and the United States Marine Corps, actually have some foundational similarities. The Marine Corps continues to hold steadily to its original doctrine, unity and commitments, even in the face of the cultural and governmental moral decline--and invasive wokism. It exemplifies loyalty. And we know the Christian Church has been faithful to take the Gospel light to the nations, spiritually enlighten people groups, and contribute to America’s founding and strong national character. Yet, the American Church–the denominations, their churches, ministers and people thereof, has been subjected to a gradual spiritual and moral decline for years. In fact, from its very beginning, Christianity has long suffered manifold, uncorrected problems resulting from settling itself on an unstable, Torah-less, unstable foundation, and now embraces degrees of doctrinal instability, and rejects the full ministry of the Holy Spirit. Thus it operates from a diminished potential, but one that can be quickly corrected. At this juncture though, denominational converts to Messiah Yeshua are still not being fully equipped as true disciples with whole-truth education. Juxtaposing will reveal more lucidly the prominent strengths, spiritual compromises, shortfalls, and restoration needs of either the Corps or our westernized Church. Blatant weaknesses must be addressed and corrected. We will do the contrasting and grading in Part Two, but first a confession.

I’m a 45 year follower and servant of Yeshua. I am also a former Marine, a veteran. Do these groups have anything in common concerning their enlistees? YES! Allow me to present a short testimony.

Welcome to Parris Island

In September, 1965, I stepped down from a Greyhound bus at the notorious Parris Island Marine Corps Recruit Depot in South Carolina. As I did a startling visage immediately gripped my attention! I was greeted by a large white sign that carried a foreboding message in bold black lettering. So too were the other wide-eyed, travel weary recruits “welcomed”--even everyone who accompanied me. The large, unavoidable wording declared: "The Marine Corps demands Discipline, Devotion to Duty, and Teamwork." The words requests, please, and thank you were conspicuously absent. Hence, I saw this in-your-face "hello" not merely as a strongly worded recommendation, but for what it actually was--a foreboding Old Corps ultimatum to be taken very seriously. Developing these character attributes was in fact an order that best be promptly comprehended and followed. At that time I had no idea that the Marine Corps’ espoused cohesive militant standards were entirely compatible with Scripture's requirements for aspiring disciples of Yeshua. In either case, the development of them would serve me well in the years to come. See Matthew 16:24.

Anyway, the unfriendly introduction caused my apprehension level concerning the future to spike! This took place during the days of the unforgiving Old Corps with its narrow and stifling wooden barracks, metal mess trays, nose-to-head lines, biting sand fleas, M-14 rifles, and tough male drill instructors--who did more than just scream at recruits. Indeed, there were other unpleasantries and punishments to endure. Nevertheless, we Marine hopefuls learned quickly to respect our leaders, follow orders, and fulfill our responsibilities.

In fact, the challenge was invigorating and bonded the recruits. That is how things should be for the saints as well, but usually are not. This has got to change! Messianic discipleship, without a doubt, requires effort, and personal religious standards that are in cadence with the Corp’s demands for–discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork. Re-reading the Book of Acts is a good exercise because, by it, YHWH presents to believers a spiritual template for modern, nominal Christendom to start emulating now, not tomorrow! Acts reveals the first congregation of Spirit-born saints–the Nazarenes, their pristine faith, and unmixed spiritual values. Can we emulate them–the Marines and even the Nazarene saints also.? Yes we can, and will, and must.

Nonetheless, having been deposited on the inhospitable island--a place from which no recruits had ever successfully escaped, and pondering my irrevocable, vowed commitment to military service, I took the large, intimidating black-lettered words to heart and went forward mentally prepared to comply with the austere demands of the new chapter of life I had chosen. But unknown to me, my forbearance with the Corps' dominance, demands, and strict regulations--and the subsequent rigors of infantry life and combat in Vietnam, initiated a gradual inner transformation that would contribute to conditioning me years later for a life-changing encounter with the Holy Spirit, and conversion to the Messiah.

Beforehand however, I learned quickly how serious the Corps really was concerning its posted fundamental requirements. The large sign's stern message was indeed inflexible and vigorously enforced, as if it had been "etched in stone." There was no mincing of words; no equivocation! Separation from the old, worldly life and uniting with the new one was settled and there would be no "about face." Recruits--all who had sworn loyalty to the constitution and the service, would (a) learn and (b) march in step to ALL the Corps pertinent regulations and fulfill their duties in an honorable fashion! Failure of a Marine to obey a lawful order or standing regulation constitutes a violation of Article 92 of the Uniform Code of Military Justice. This arrogance–which you can regard as lawlessness, is called "Dereliction of Duty" and harsh punishments quickly accompany it. Ignorance of the law is no excuse.

Do you, my friend, observe overt dereliction of duty by the saints in knowing but not keeping the instruction of the Most High Elohim, our Commandant, so to speak? I think many, if not most, Christian claimants fall short of the Father’s expectations, but they seem apathetic anyway. And preoccupied by their own mixed spiritual pursuits. And therein lies the source of Christendom’s demise.

A Leatherneck and a Sheep

Since I am a former Marine, I have learned to appreciate the value and profit of the Corps’ demand that its recruits develop the excellencies of personal discipline, devotion to duty, and teamwork to be esteemed and active in one’s life. I am also a disciple of Messiah Yeshua with 45 years of ministry service behind me. Naturally, I promote the development and unfading loyalty to those same Marine Corps values to be found among the saints in the body of Messiah. Anyway, I think I am as qualified as anyone to conduct a brief and simple character comparison between the two entities based on their adherence to each one’s fundamental commitments. Humans are involved in each, and both groups can therefore undergo scrutiny and grading. One is of earthly origin and the other of heavenly--but both, for now, are earthbound. Thus, like others before me, I have fought against the enemies of both groups, using physical weapons as a Marine when required, and spiritual weapons as a Saint of the Most High when necessary also. The dark oppressors of freedom that confront both organizations are undergirded by the powers and deceptions of fallen angels and hordes of demonic spirits. Therefore, contrasting the compliance of each to their law and prime directives, devotion to duty, discipline, and team unity--will help believers assess the integrity of their associations and reflect on our own lives as well.

Conclusion: Our examination of how both the Church and the Marine Corps measure up—not to to one another, but to the same five mutual fundamental standards that will be revealed in our comparison to be posted in Part 2– which is next. There will be room for your evaluations and scoring conclusions also. Meet me there, brethren. Let’s finish together!

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

item.title: Contender’s Voice: A Faith Restoration Update
item.description: A Bi-Monthly Whole Truth Restoration and Spiritual Warfare Report
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Contender’s Voice: A Faith Restoration Update on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

For Audio: Click the black triangle above right.

Welcome aboard followers of Messiah Yeshua, and all messianic believers who have been summoned by our Almighty Elohim to contend for the restoration of the original, apostolic Nazarene faith once delivered to the saints. See Jude 1:3. The picture above is relevant to that divine directive. It serves as a metaphor depicting two re-emerging towers that portray spiritual forces re-emerging, and doing so in our unstable constitutional republic. One represents the blessed rise of the Torah among the followers of Yeshua. The other portrays the ascension within our nation of the spirit of Babel, or ancient Babylon, which is captivating and realigning our deteriorating culture. We should not be surprised by the appearance of these opposing spiritual powers, for it is written: “And that which has been done is that which will be done [again]. There is nothing new under the sun” (Ecclesiastes 1:9). In other words: “What goes around, comes around.”

Full restoration of undiminished biblical truth, which is very much needed by western Christendom, is indeed occurring in America -- but not without much demonically generated religious and secular resistance. Nevertheless, the recovery of Torah-based faith realities will occur and become embraced by the many prodigal saints who are repenting, returning to the Father’s house, and contentedly honoring His clear instructions. They aspire to be full-fledged disciples of Yeshua, our Good Shepherd, and nothing less. This widespread Latter Days spiritual confrontation, which is on steroids so to speak, is underway and gaining momentum as you read. The towers are rising! So, with this colossal spiritual conflict going on right under our noses, shouldn’t believers enlist and engage in this militant campaign as we are led by the Holy Spirit! Each of us is summoned and needed in this existential fray. After all, as it is written, He called out: “FollowMe…” (Mark 1:17). This command appears 21 times in Scripture, and each time the word “please” is conspicuously absent. If you are yielded to the Holy Spirit in this hour of global transformation, my friend, you will, by God’s grace—sooner or later, end up facing the Torah. This is important. Considering the challenging and dangerous times that loom ahead and threaten the entire world it would indeed be best for all who claim Yeshua as Savior to truly know Him.

Questions: So, is Yeshua Ha Mashiach, the crucified, buried, and resurrected Son of God–-simply a life coach, a career consultant, or a self-actualization advocate for believers today. Or has western Christianity overlooked that He is indeed something else altogether? So, let’s scrutinize Him again through the lens of the sacred Scriptures and not interpret them by our modern-day, western mindset, but rather be roused as we rediscover who He truly is and start relating to Him biblically.

“In the beginning was the Word, and the Word [the living Torah] was with God, and the Word was God” (John 1:1).

Central Truth: Contender’s Voice is a ministry promoting the Torah-based, solid rock restoration of the Ecclesia’s original foundation of faith. In order to proceed with this vision the builders, so to speak, must first recognize Yeshua as the living Torah--the very embodiment of divine truth. Hence, He is also Adonai, a title of authority that demands respect and honor, and speaks of His divine power and jurisdiction over all creation. Isaiah wrote of Him, “He will swallow up death forever; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from all faces, and the reproach of His people He will take away from the whole earth” (Isaiah 25:8). In other words, He will assert His victory over death and sorrow and we will then rejoice in His Kingdom and exalt Him forever!

He unequivocally commands His followers, whom He loves, to be disciples and follow Him in compliance with His instructions. Keep in mind, He baptizes His disciples and empowers them with the Holy Spirit, Who also serves as our Guide, Teacher, and Comforter. Once we are “born of the Spirit” He puts a cross on our backs, and sets us on the narrow road of self-denial and obedience--a journey to eternity by which the saints can mature and grow into overcomers bearing love-based fruit that shows love for Him and our neighbor.

This is the bedrock of unsullied worship.The true, non-westernized Jesus (Yeshua) of Scripture, as compassionate as He is, wants committed disciples, not nominal converts or casual believers who contentedly straddle the two paths of life--wouldn’t you say, dear reader? There is no middle ground for the Called Out Assembly. The title Adonai–My LORD, well describes the non institutionalized, but rather a full-fledged living Torah–Yeshua – who asserts His rulership and requires the submission of His loyal followers–for their good and His glory. Are you one of them, dear reader?

We who honor His love-based instructions are destined to win! But be sure of this–He does not mince words. They are without equivocation. So here is another question: “Why do you [we] call Me [Him] LORD and not do what I say” (Luke 6:46). Friends, if we love Him we will love His clear and strong instructions also, and not find ways to avoid them such as we do with the fourth commandment. In failing to honor and thus follow His words, such as recorded in Matthew 7:24-27, we have become subpar “salt and light” and suffer spiritual and secular reproach–even though we might still produce good works.

Anyway, to recover, the saints must make “teshuvah” – a commitment to deep repentance and a complete turn around from all evil to holy moral, mental, and physical living. Then pray for a broad“chayah”-- which means to be quickened and restored from spiritual sickness to the source of pure life. Such is the product of a revival of Yahweh’s Instructions. And then, we have been commanded to make talmidim, or disciples. This means building a relationship, as a student, with one’s master. A talmidim is a learner, or a student, who is deeply devoted to an esteemed teacher and ardently seeks to become like his teacher and emulate His ways.

Exhortation: It is written to Israel concerning God’s commandments: “You shall bind them as a sign on your hand and they shall be as frontlets on your forehead“ (Deuteronomy 6:8). In other words, YHWH’s mark, His law, is to be within the head and the hand– which means it is to occupy and direct the mind and control the behavior of the Israelite. His Word is meant to be demonstrated in the lives of His people. Likewise, the antichrist mark, his satanic, damning lies, will become etched into the minds of countless reprobates and lived out by them. The issue centers upon a person’s inner life whereby techno-chip et all are simply precursors, indications of the beast’s marks or influences already seated. In other words, physical identity indicators willingly accepted are the result the a mindset and antichrist lifestyles already developed within the backslidden believers or reprobate people. The crumbling culture is a clear testimony that very few Christians–those called and equipped to be the salt and light of the culture, have actually followed the instructions of Deuteronomy 6:8.

We are created to glorify Yeshua. Therefore, let’s go beyond a relationship status and become genuine disciples and friends who go forward into a spiritual friendship-fellowship with our Savior. Remember His words: “My sheep hear my voice [they recognize His teachings], and I know them [in spiritual intimacy], and they follow Me [or they obey and live according to His pure teaching]” (John 10:27). Note: Brackets inserted by C.V.

Spiritual problems that were appearing in the nineteenth century have manifested greatly and are deeply rooted and affecting our culture today as well. Neither will they be squelched until the Body of Messiah embraces a whole truth revival. The roots of America’s spiritual and secular deterioration are deep, and the anti-Bible causes that were rising long ago are alive, enlarged, and producing bad fruit today. In fact, G.H.Pember, a nineteenth century Christrian writer, wrote Earth’s Earliest Ages that cites the relentless march of spiritual demise that would lead to the Tribulation. I have included several of the old spiritual developments of his era for your consideration.

First, the rapid progression of mechanical arts and inventions. We have highly advanced technology shaping our lives and beliefs more than ever now.

Secondly, the undue elevation of the female sex, a work of the spiritual force called Jezebel. It’s a type of unsanctioned reversals.

Thirdly, the disregard of the sanctity of marriage and family order. What ever happened to the male leadership?

Fourthly, the blending of westernized, institutional Christianity with worldly systems.

Fifthly, evidence of the presence and reality of the principalities of the air was apparent and spiritualistic mysticism gained popularity then. It’s rampant in our culture today.

Sixthly, the false notion that heavenly bliss for everyone and happy reunions come quickly following death was held by many, along with unbelief in Hell and the Lake of Fire for the damned. John 3:36. These are just a few examples of the rise and expansion of unbiblical doctrines and trends that sprang up from Torah-less faith foundations, and such unsettling trends are continuing and branching out today.

Again, the Ecclesia’s chief causes of doctrinal deterioration, denominational conflict, the mixing of falsehood with truth, the diversity of profitless errant doctrines, spiritual lawlessness, and a misunderstanding of Yeshua--are all the unholy products of rejecting the centrality of the Torah to our faith. Further, the shelving of the full ministry of the Holy Spirit and consequential subpar salt-and-light ministry are also the results of the historic rejection of the Law of Moses–which is the Torah. And let us be sure--the rich Hebraic faith culture and the believers’ Israelite identity are also centered upon the Torah—and are also missing. So, the Christendom colossus –- both Catholicism and Protestantism, abide spiritually subdued in this spiritual miasma and remain scripturally incomplete. Yet many Christians seem to not care. Nevertheless, the diversity of false doctrines that developed and followed the spread of the Gospel are existentially consequential. A reformation is absolutely needed—a restoration of Torah to the Ecclesia. Contenders are being summoned. You are one of them! Don’t back off. Start a Torah School in your home. We have the material for this wonderful undertaking.

Earth’s Cosmic Conflict and Restoring Apostolic Torah-based Faith involves you.

Reformation is occurring amidst the growth of two existential forces–Torah restoration and the AI Tech revolution. Our Reformation Report is designed to serve you by evaluating the messianic, Torah-based, faith restoration phenomenon that’s underway in the nation and chart its progress and impact within the realm of Christendom. What’s more, the Reformation Report will also unveil the Torah’s restoration’s benefit to both the modern Ecclesia, or nominal westernized Christianity, but also the crumbling American republic itself. Reformation is indeed occurring amidst the growth of two existential forces of social, even national reformation–Torah restoration and the AI Tech revolution.

Five Priorities for Advancing Disciples.

With this in mind our Update presents five basic priorities by which visionary believers dealing with prophetic developments can profit. Therefore, as you read be sure to prayerfully evaluate them and consider how each applies to your life.

1. Take notice of the vastly different world views of the Torah recovery reformation with that of the AI Transhumanist revolution. “There is a great chasm fixed…” between them. Consider Luke 16:26.

2. Evaluate and judge the incompatible values and dissimilar visions to which each of these movements is inherently connected.

3. Begin to reject humanist beliefs and practices, which are spiritual detriments, and recover and restore fundamental Torah doctrines and the ministry of the Holy Spirit. Both the Torah and the full ministry of the Holy Spirit exalt Messiah Yeshua are necessities of the original, apostolic faith.

4. Read with the guidance of the Spirit of Messiah.This union should engender repentance, sanctification, and conformance to the instructions and commandments of Yahweh our Elohim. This commitment is required for real disciples.

5. Become open to Spiritual duty of contending for the original Nazarene, Torah–centered faith–known as “The Way.” This pentecostal faith was taught and modeled by the Messiah and His Apostles, and followed by the early disciples. Therefore, we contend for the restoration of this unadulterated spiritual model of biblical purity and practice. Thus, today’s modern Christians, professors of Messiah Yeshua who aspire to messianic discipleship, have important discipleship prerequisites, or essentials, to recognize and embrace.

Reminder: Whole Truth Restoration requires the Ecclesia--the Called-out-Assembly of Yeshua, who is the Living Torah, to turn converts into obedient disciples of the sacred Word! See Matthew 28:19 and 20; Romans 1:5 and 16: 26.

It is written: “...and the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen His glory, glory as of the only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth” (John 1:14). Contender’s Voice is set on recovering the Torah, proclaiming the glory of Yeshua in a reprobate culture, and restoring the original apostolic Nazarene faith. This vision comprises our “reason-for-being”. A reformation is underway, therefore be very wise and build your future, life and generational legacy securely on the solid rock foundation of the Saviour’s Word in Matthew 7:24-27.

If you comply, blessed reader, you will do well and grow in grace on the narrow road to which you have been summoned by the divine Son. During your stay on earth let the joy of the LORD be your portion and holy conduct and godliness be your standard. 2 Peter 3:11. Then you will become one of Yeshua’s many over-comers and no weapon of demonic origin will overcome you. Pray His Word and remember the promises. They will provide hope, stir faith, and gird you with gladness and a good expectation for the future!

Announcement:

Torah and Glory Home School: Our one-year long, five part Torah Commentary Course is available. I encourage you, blessed reader, to enroll. Information is available on our website, Contender’s Voice. Click on manuals and the Torah Commentary Manuals and open it.

The materials are available on Amazon or without charge on our site. You may download , copy, and use each Torah and Glory Commentary manual freely. Click on the following link – https://www.contendersvoice.com/introduction.

The essential Six Discipleship Prerequisites are coming. Please pay close attention to them. So be sure to meet me at the next blog—our coming activistic Restoration Update. Our Elohim has wonderful promises prepared for His beloved faithful contenders. These believers--probably a minority, are those who engage in recovering and restoring His whole truth to the Ecclesia, or Called Out Assembly. Thus, the Torah and Spirit restoration prospect is exciting and its pursuit will benefit us individually, but could also be very beneficial to both the secular and spiritual realms of our nation.

The pathway to your blessing, dear friend, has been made clear for us. It is written: “If you abide in Me and My words abide in you, then you will ask for anything you wish, and you shall have it” (John 15:7). Do you know what that really means? If you don’t I will be happy to write and inform you. Tamid Kadima-Alway Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a subscriber. For each person who subscribes I will sent to your email the Evaluation AAI made of Contenders Voice. It is very interesting aand informative
