item.title: Victory by Faith
item.description: “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ” (1 Corinthians 15:57).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Victory by Faith on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Part One

There is one faith which YHWH has completely sanctioned, fully honored, and entrusted to His apostolic saints–-for them to guard and proclaim until the second coming of the risen King of Glory occurs. It is comprised of His words of life–the Scriptures, which have pretty much covered the earth. His faith–some refer to it as orthodoxy, is the only one to pass muster, so to speak! The Book of Acts reveals this faith being embraced by the original Nazarene Israelites. It is the way of victory over sin, death, and evil forces. And it is Torah-based, Spirit empowered, and Messiah centric. So, with that in mind, let’s unpack this topic–-the “Victory of Faith,” by taking a trip down memory lane to review and consider something Israel achieved in the Wilderness on their march to Canaan…and what it means to us today.

The accounts of ancient Israel’s adventures that the nation encountered, as it advanced through hostile Amorite territory on its way to the Promised Land, supplies modern believers with profound testimonies of the love and faithfulness of Yahweh. Indeed, Israel’s Elohim inspired faith, imparted wisdom, and infused military prowess to His people according to their need especially when facing hostilities. He thereby enabled them to fulfill His instructions and continue forward to their assigned destiny–-under providential oversight. So, here is one event we shall consider. It is written: "We turned and went up the road to Bashan: and Og the King of Bashan came out against us..." (De. 3:1-11). Og was a genuine giant. The massive Rapha’im King, who was considerably larger than Goliath, was a formidable and merciless pagan adversary. [Note: The gargantuan Amorite slept on an iron-framed bed of about 13.5 to 14 feet in length and 6 feet wide. It might have been larger, actually, since Rabbinic tradition holds that the cubit measurements were of the giant’s proportions, not those of a smaller, common human. See 1] He ruled a vast area–-the region of Argob which was populated with giants. It held sixty cities that were built upon basaltic rock with strong black stones. Hence, the districts and towns of Bashan were ominous, threatening, and impregnable in appearance. Consequently, Og and his daunting Nephilim forces would, at first glance, look unconquerable…to anyone. Insurmountable. Still, by faith in their Elohim, Israel went forward to engage the overly confident, intimidating army...and annihilated it. This makes Israel's sudden, complete, and decisive defeat of Og and his kingdom, which was so heavily populated, powerfully defended, geographically favored, and ruled by a company of giants--so utterly astonishing. As a result of their great conquest the Israelites’ confidence and courage levels spiked upward, as did fear of the Israeli multitudes surge in the hearts of the surrounding nations that lay in their path. Og had come out with all his people fully armed against the Israelites. He was nevertheless promptly and completely routed. The conquered land and the cities were taken and possessed by Israel who met the conditions for such success, which are: (a) fearlessness--"Be strong and courageous..." (Joshua 1:6) and (b) faith, i.e. dependence on the Almighty for divine assistance–-"Trust in the LORD with all thine heart...” (Prov. 3:5). What does this paragraph have to do with my life today, you ask? It serves as a reminder that, though our adversities may be foreboding, they can indeed be overcome.

Consider the power and extent of lawlessness and gross immorality existent in our nation, for instance. America was once a republic of lawfulness, moral rectitude and behavioral normality. The culture has been changed however, by the flood of mixed media transmission infiltrating our institutions, and the resultant spreading of spiritual wickedness and its compliant human minions. We are now inhabited by a population that harbors mixed standards for living–-many of whom have been given over to woke values and reprobate, unholy thinking. We must have a full-fledged biblical revival accompanying the restoration of the republic if we expect to prevail. See Romans 1. Our fouled social condition is itself an adversary of decency and godly morality. Notwithstanding, the new administration recognizes the problem and is taking steps to restore moral and social normalcy to the nation. This is a good initial effort for change. But the real enemy is the spiritual component underlying the nation's spiritual and secular corruption. This enemy cannot be defeated by human weapons. To gain a strong and enduring victory spiritual weapons must be employed by fervent restoration contenders of Yahweh’s genuine apostolic faith. This step will initiate a cure of the spiritual and moral plague. But is there a countervailing force to which we have access that cannot be defeated? Absolutely! Is there a way people can vanquish the widespread underlying dark spiritual forces energizing and directing the demonic upheaval? Yes, there is! We saints procure Yahweh’s intervention and blessing by abiding in His sacred instructions–that means keeping His commands-all that are known, applicable, and doable at this time and thereby dislodging the elements of spiritual darkness. Those given in 2 Chronicles 7:14 and Ephesians 6:10-18 provide the wisdom–a foremost weapon of warfare, and the needed tools and responsibilities for restoration contenders..

Bolstered by such a commitment we contenders could take Paul’s words to heart: “For I can do everything through [faith in] the Messiah who gives me strength” (Phil. 4:13). Yeshua is our High Priest, ever interceding for His saints before the throne of the Father. Did you know that Yeshua is cited by the first word, of the first verse, of the first page, of the first chapter, of the first book of the Torah–Beresheit. Yeshua is the resheit of beresheit! It means first fruits, beginnings, the source, firstly, best, and inception–all of which point to the living Torah, Yeshua our blessed Messiah. He is first in all blessed things. And be sure of this! He wants–and is entitled to, first place in our lives also. No other place will do.

Our spiritual warfare tactics, listed in Ephesians 6:10-18, include using the Word of God as a two edged sword by proclaiming it openly, boldly, and vocally while in prayer And do so in the face of life’s carnal challenges and infernal temptations. Remember David! Re-read the account in First Samuel. David declared to the face of the giant, Goliath, “I come against you in the name of the LORD Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel…” (1 Samuel 17:45). The young man’s bold and true declaration of faith set the stage for victory. The giant fell dead and the Philistines fled the battlefield. In any case, we can see clearly that He has good things ahead for you, dear reader–promises He has yet to fulfill. Therefore, let’s repent of debilitating worldliness and pray, become sanctified, and persist in proclaiming our alliance with Yeshua and His truth in the face of demonic conflict. Believers today–-if they align with divine instructions, are destined to be overcomers as were Moses and Israel long ago, and King David also. Remember, Yeshua has already won the victory. In rebuilding a broken nation on a sure biblical foundation–-such faith will be required. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward

1.Wikipedia

Part Two

“Ask for the ancient paths…and walk therein…” (Jer. 6:16).

In the verse posted above we hear the prophet Jeremiah speaking to Judah long ago to turn away from their lawbreaking and idolatry and return to the old paths, the good ways of the Torah. His ancient words find room in modern, backslidden America also. The call of the prophet Hosea is also beginning to be heard again. His words went forth to the wayward, sinful people of Israel. The order was made long ago–-”Return O Israel to YHWH your Elohim, for you have stumbled and fallen [visited with mounting troubles] because of your sin” (Hosea 14:1). The appeal was made to the Northern Kingdom of Israel but has applications for Yahweh's covenant saints today, even in America, who hope for a cultural restoration but are currently abiding in a corrupted nation. It is a last hour summons to come back to the path of Scripture’s foundations of truth! Call it a life line thrown out to floundering swimmers struggling in the cold waters of a Nor’easter storm. It’s a metaphor pointing to restoring the republic’s rule of law along biblical lines. Wisdom will especially be needed during the period of building a golden age society for America, especially as AI technology becomes its nervous system, if you will, and transhumanism emerges as the over-shadowing cultural influence. Let us therefore remember–the pathway to wisdom, and a victorious spiritual and moral change for the nation, is founded in the exercise of biblical faith! It is the core of spiritual warfare.

While the administration’s executive orders are initiating beneficial governmental changes in America ….and national hope for a restoration of normalcy has risen. But we remain in the throes of social conflict, lawlessness, and gross cultural decline. Our depraved, deeply ingrained societal condition has progressed to the point that’s beyond the scope of human repair and resuscitation. We know this, I’m sure. Thus, divine intervention must be invoked by repentant people across the nation, in order to reinforce recovery efforts, don’t you think? In a nutshell, the nation is spiritually conflated and politically conflicted. Behind the temporal scene we see the institutional westernized church, tasked by the Almighty for preserving and proclaiming pure biblical truth, but ill-equipped to do so. That Torah-based faith which was taught and followed by the early, apostolic Ecclesia, started to become disfigured long ago. Consequently, because of misleading errant teachings and customs that entered the expanding Ecclesia, this responsibility has not been followed for many centuries. Christendom has become spiritually ill-prepared for the most part, and no longer holds a strong full-biblical influence on western people. Institutional Christianity, aside from its history of missions and social good works, is an entity that has drifted far away from its original Hebraic heritage and hence has given up much spiritual strength and scriptural truth potential for guidance and service. In the days of the apostles, Jude the Nazarene elder of the early assembly, recognized the growing problem of false teaching and the assault on Hebraic costumes as serious problems that needed immediate attention. He wrote this edict: “Contend for the [pure, unmixed] faith once for all delivered (entrusted) to the saints” (1:3). He urged the Judean believers to vigorously defend the truth taught by Yeshua and the Apostles. Among the costs of the dilution of sacred truth was a diminished potential for gaining spiritual victory over the works of darkness–then and now also. This is a modern day Og situation…and we are Yahweh’s ingrafted, Spirit-born Israelites with a destiny of our own to fulfill! Do we repent, pray, become sanctified, and fulfil our contender role to oppose the spiritual enemy? Or faint and abide mired in deceptions? Tell me what you think, dear reader? Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Parts 3 and 4 are next. They review the Victory by Faith that comes through our Redeemer, Messiah Yeshua. So, let’s meet at the next post. Hutch Church

item.title: Tamid Kadima - Always Forward
item.description: "You have stayed at this mountain long enough. Its time to break camp and move on" (See Deuteronomy 1:5-8).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Tamid Kadima - Always Forward on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

There are four essential requirements for anyone who, having been led by the Spirit, wants to (1) cross over from Satan's dark dominion and join the ranks of Yahweh's disciples in the Kingdom of God, (2) experience sublime spiritual fellowship with the Father and His Son by the Communion of the Holy Spirit, (3) be blessed with mental and emotional health--the widely sought peace-of-soul desired by many people, especially amidst troublesome social upheavals. These seekers realize this world's pervasive antichrist communication systems, inspired and energized by an underlying sentient spiritual component, is twisting the the nation's ethos causing much social confliction. Up to this point the demonic assault has succeeded. Americans, both young and old, live exposed to this technology's effusive outpouring of contradictory information and it presents a serious challenge to the spiritual stability of the country. It's a double edged sword, actually, that spews out volumes of deceptive misinformation thereby impugning the integrity of the holy Scriptures, misdirecting seekers with wearisome philosophies and social theories, and obfuscating the Gospel of salvation. The weight of modern media output also militates against pure biblical faith and it's life-changing prophetic vision, and thereby divides the nominal Church into thousands of organizations and the Bible into many interpretations and arguments. A spiritual, Torah-based restoration is needed in the Ecclesia--the Called Out Assembly, wouldn't you agree? A "Truth Revival" highlighting Yeshua, the fullness of the Torah, the complete ministry of the Holy Spirit, and discipleship is our need. Hence, the Elohim of Israel reminds the saints of the purity of His holy Word with this countervailing encouragement: "For these commands are a lamp and this teaching is light; and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life" (Proverbs 6:23). Selah. Hold up His Word over your path each day. Now, lets go visit the Four Essentials together----take on one per day if you'd like! They are the heaven-ward steps of crossing over and abiding in the victory wrought for us by the atonement, shed blood, and resurrection of our blessed Messiah, Yeshua.

Four Essentials.

First, It is written: "I tell you the truth, no one can see the Kingdom of God unless he is born again [regenerated by the Holy Spirit]" (John 3:3). Heed the instructions of John's Gospel. Everyone coming to Messiah and the Kingdom of God must be (a) convinced of His divine Sonship, (b) surrendered entirely to the sacred truth vouchsafed by the Holy Spirit, and (c) assured of salvation in Messiah by faith alone--and be born-again. This is a spiritual "birth" occurring within someone being regenerated by the Holy Spirit, who puts Yahweh's law in the mind and on the heart. This spiritual phenomenon is wonderful and miraculous. This foretold blessing written of by Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Joel, is experienced by "whosoever believeth in Him," the Son, Messiah Yeshua --as Savior. It is written in Ephesians 2:8-9: "For you are saved by grace through faith; it is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God." Further the convert, at the moment of salvation and the new birth, is "...delivered from the kingdom of darkness and translated into the kingdom of light" (see Colossians 1:13-17). The spiritual crossover results in the convert being redeemed from satanic power and becoming a new creation in Messiah, and subject only to the instructions, goodness and freedom of God.

Secondly, it is written: "...and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free" (John 8:32). Let's clarify that verse. The truth of God must be studied and understood in order to liberate one's mind from fear, evil thoughts, and deception, and inspire them to follow the Way--the teachings of Messiah and all His apostles. However, freedom is completed, if you will, and sustained once the believer begins to comply with Yahweh's truth. Separation from sin and turning to righteousness is called -- sanctification. It is alluded to in Psalm 91 as "dwelling in the secret place of the Most High". The hearer simply must become a doer of the Word. To practice what we have learned is a duty and a privilege for every saint. Obedience to known and doable instruction is the key that opens the trailhead of the disciples journey with Messiah. It's an essential! Paul describes His mission in both the beginning and ending of Romans: It was "...to bring about the obedience of faith among all the Gentiles for His name's sake..." See Roman 1:5 and Romans 16:26 also. Re-read Matthew 28:19-20.

Thirdly, it is written: The resurrected Messiah spoke to His followers before His ascension and said: " ...wait for what the Father had promised, which He said, you heard of from Me; for John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now" (Acts 1:4-5) and "...you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you; and you shall be my witnesses..." (verse 8). Be baptized in the Holy Spirit. This blessing satisfies the need for purification, power, and enthusiasm for believing disciples, and falls in step with the words of John the Baptist concerning the Messiah's ministry. "He will baptize you with the Holy Sprit and fire" (Matthew 3:11). Amen. Have you, blessed reader, been baptized by Yeshua with the Holy Spirit?

Fourthly, it is written: "Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations..." (Matthew 28:19). Become a disciple of our Messiah and coming King, Yeshua, and a servant of His purposes, foremost of which is making disciples. . It takes a disciple to "make disciples." Do not remain a convert or nominal believer, but enroll in His "School of Faith" as a committed student of His truth and diligently follow all the applicable instructions of our Messiah. The disciples goal is to become like his or her teacher and devoted adherent of the teacher's words! [Question: Doesn't everyone abide by some set of rules, values, words, or a general body of information--be they subjective, objective, an eclectic philosophic, ideologic, or new age mystical blend ? Yes! We all follow some sort of paradigm that shapes our lives and determines our eternity. So, with whose words or teaching are you building your life and legacy upon? Who do you really want to emulate? Be honest. Share your ideas.] It is written: "...if you love me, keep my commandments" (John 14:15). Here Yeshua clearly tells us that obedience to His commands, His instructions--is the foremost way a believer can steadfastly express unfeigned love for him. Again, a disciple is the student who wants to learn from and become like his or her teacher. Of whom are you a disciple, dear reader? Being a disciple of the Messiah requires a life-long commitment.

Paul wrote these words to Timothy and to you and me also: "Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of God" (2 Timothy 2:15). We are converted, born again, and saved to become disciples of Yeshua, dedicated students of His Torah and fervent for lawfulness. His genuine disciples are not at all inclined to be unschooled, spiritually ill-prepared converts who pick and choose "comfy" Bible verses to follow. This set-apart status to which we are summoned is a privilege. His words put faith, love, truth, and power in a disciple's heart and are the great disciplinarians of His "school of faith, hope, and love. They are holy chaperons of our lives, guardians of purity of heart and mind, and the relentless enemies of demonic deceptions. His sacred laws must be honored at all times. This bond to His instructions is expected by all who are preparing to be His Bride! Do you regard yourself as a true disciple of the Master? Do you honor the Sabbath of which He is LORD? If not, don't let Catholic doctrine, of which Protestantism is an offspring, turn you away from the Sabbath. Keep the Seventh Day. It's the only day in the Torah that was given a name by Yahweh. It is written as your assurance, blessed saint: "And we know in all things God works for the good of those who love Him, who have been called according to His purpose" (Romans 8:28). It is a sign uniting Yahweh and His people in close fellowship. Good things lie ahead for you. Amen.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward.

Hutch Church. Shalom.

item.title: From Sand to Rock - Part 3
item.description: "Everyone who hears these words of mine and acts on them may be compared to a wise man who built his house [life, or legacy] on a rock." (see Mt. 7:24-27).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of From Sand to Rock - Part 3 on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Do you realize, brethren, that living is building? That's right! A person's varied labors actually create a habitation--a house of values so to speak, in which the worker dwells. And the security of the constructed "edifice" is directly related to the strength, resilience, and moral character of the structure's foundation. Let us cut to the chase. Obedience to Yeshua's instructions--His words, is the durable foundation required for spiritually upholding the lives of all His saints. You could say they are life's building blocks. The verse posted above serves as a warning about the insufficiency of superficial faith. It settles for building one's "house" upon a faulty base -- i.e., sand mixed with the broken rocks of worldly values. Such builders reject the sum of Yeshua's teachings and are therefore not doers of the Word. They are cherry pickers. Their values would be something other than the uncompromised instructions of the Messiah. It is of great consequence that each of us consider Yeshua's counsel against the backdrop of judgment and eternity. Hence we perceive that His building code applies to all our undertakings. Come along with me as Contender's Voice reveals the momentous consequence of adhering to His words of instruction in this unfolding era of deception and geopolitical change. Remember, ye favored of Yahweh, to -- (a) carefully read the material of Contender's Voice, (b) compare its assertions to the teaching of the Word of God, and (c) determine for yourself our validity. I appreciate your interest and pray for the Father to enlighten you, and me too, with deepening knowledge of our Savior.

But what's the central truth this blog is based upon. It is this imperative: It's high time for the Bride of Messiah--all Spirit-born believers, to awaken to their primary purpose as described in Ephesians 2:10, and comply with the message! It is written: "For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus [Messiah Yeshua] for good works [obedience] which God [Yahweh] prepared beforehand that we should walk in them." To fulfill this instruction, however, most believers will need to recalibrate their denominational faith, recover and embrace the Torah, and diligently prepare themselves for the advent of the King of Glory! Although everyone is being summoned to return to the Father's house and His instructions, it is likely that only a responsible remnant will respond! Revelation 19:7. Those who dilly-dally in their preparation for the kingdom of heaven will find themselves crying out, "Lord, lord, open up for us.” But the King will respond: “Truly I say to you. I do not know you" (see Matthew 25:1-13). Nobody wants to hear those words!

His betrothed will be challenged. Sanctification, which is a duty to which the saint should be devoted, will demand increased effort and self-sacrifice in the days looming ahead. Nevertheless, we must come out from under the spell of Babylon. See Revelation 18:4. G.H. Pember wrote this pertinent--to the point--comment 150 years ago yet it finds even greater application today: "Yeshua's saints (that’s us) profess to praise, worship, and obey the eternal Elohim of Israel, and can appear to be very diligent, energetic, and enthusiastic in the outward expression of their faith, but--if at the same time we are following/obeying the law (the evil, anti-Torah ways) of Satan and ignoring the clear commands of the Messiah, then Satan’s subjects we are reckoned to be. And the law of Satan is this -- that we yield to demonic deceptions and temptations, and (a) seek all our pleasure in, and (b) fix all our heart-felt hopes upon, this present age--over which he (Satan) presides...and that we (c) use all our best endeavors by the means of various sensuous and intellectual occupations and delights which he has provided to hold our thoughts and ambitions focused on countless ways of wasting and killing time while journeying on the broad road to damnation." The words present a very sobering prospect, indeed. [1] Conclusion --> Prepare yourself to give an account of your life to Him who judges the living and the dead. But, as you go forward remember His words. They present encouragement and inspire hope. Believe His promises and remain confident in your life’s journey, blessed reader. It is written: "Those who know your name will trust in you, for you LORD, have never forsaken those who seek you'(Psalm 9:10). 1. Pember: Pulpit Commentary/ Matthew Edition on page 297, WFA--amplified by Contender's Voice.

The modern era of widespread social upheavals has been brought about by a multitude of injurious cultural developments, including these two that are among the paramount antagonists—the (a) rise of social media with the flood of conflicting and misleading information, and the (b) disregard of the nation at large for the authority of Yahweh's prophetic Scriptures. Yet, a spiritual awakening appears to be happening in the country and a biblically-based truth revolution, that is much needed, appears to be underway as the foundation of the budding revival. This portends better things are coming to the nation. Continue to pray!

As prophesied by the apostle Paul, we abide in an era of "difficult times" (2 Timothy 3:1), a period of lawlessness that was characteristic of the antediluvian days of the Watchers, Noah, and the Nephilim hybrids. Psychic communications between humans and evil spirits of other dimensions are becoming as common now as they were during the era of Babel. What's more, this timeframe stretches to encompasses the 5th, 6th, and 7th seals of Revelation, (2) the war of Gog and Magog, (3) the consequential establishment of a transhumanist New World Order, and (4) the seven year Tribulation period, to cite a few outstanding prophetic features. Seals 1 through 4 are historic and futuristic. They symbolize the spiritual forces that have ushered the world into this transhumanist era. Despite the national surge toward restoration—a very hopeful vision indeed, humankind as a whole—whether religious or not, remains under the spiritual dominion of Satan's dark kingdom. This invisible empire is housed in the second heaven. It is comprised of angelic thrones, wicked dominions, evil principalities and imperceptible (usually) spiritual powers ever working to supervise and corrupt the affairs of mankind and obfuscate the Gospel. These vast forces of sentient beings works feverishly to undermine both secular and spiritual restoration campaigns and have prevented these efforts from fully succeeding. This is the "darkness" of which Paul speaks of in Ephesians. We surmise this condemned sentient force intends to overtake and even direct the AI industrial revolution for its own infernal purpose of expanding the kingdom of darkness and spiritual wickedness throughout the planet. But people can still find biblical encouragements suited for anyone who is (a) seeking freedom from the oppressive weight of this “era of deception” and (b) wanting to be separated from it. Their hope is to crossover into a different dimension, a truly glorious one, and become sanctified and set apart from the present darkness. Such a kingdom exists but is found only in the Son of God . It is written: "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except by me" (John 14:6). Yeshua is that truth and the only way to eternal life. It is time for the Bride of Yeshua to take seriously the call to prepare herself for His coming! See Timothy 3 and 4; Revelation 19:7 It is also written: "For He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness where sin and evil reign and brought us into the realm of light, and righteousness which is Jesus Christ's kingdom" (Col. 1:13). This grand deliverance results in a complete change of allegiance and belonging for the convert who crosses over from one dominion to another one far superior. Further, it is accompanied by a radical, miraculous transformation. Our next blog, #4 in the mini-series, will address the requirements of membership in the ranks of the crossovers.

The Messianic Nazarenes were compassionate concerning the spiritual condition of their fellow Israelites who were illiterate regarding how the Torah and the Prophets pointed to Yeshua of Nazareth as the Messiah. Review Luke 24:25-27. They exhorted others in their day to crossover from unbelief to faith in the crucified and resurrected Messiah and commit fully to "the good Way" taught by Him and the Apostles. Therefore, as the early contenders did, committed saints must (a) learn to love and promote our Elohim's ancient Torah paths and (b) closely adhere to all those that are applicable. Such devotion is not legalism at all. Rather, it is humble compliance to divine instructions which is the foremost biblical expression of un-compromised faith and unfeigned love. Further, obedience refreshes and sustains spiritual vitality and enhances prophetic vision! Western saints who "go over to another side," or the Hebraic side of faith, become ebers -- or crossovers. By the way, eber is the root of the word, Hebrew. It's a word that means to cross over or pass through. To become a crossover a person transitions from errant old ways of life and faith to Yahweh's unabridged, irrefutable Torah truth and it's faith lifestyle. Today, an eber would be a person who, under Elohim's direction, leaves his or her old lifestyle of Torah-less religion behind and "crosses over" to the Father's prescribed Torah paths and walks in them as did the Messiah--perfectly!. This is Yahweh's counsel for today's spiritually deflated believers. It's a "follow Me" summons that will put them on the ancient paths leading to greater spiritual clarity, peace, and friendship-fellowship with Messiah. Deuteronomy 28: 1-12; Romans 8:16-17. This is the summons of our Good Shepherd. Psalm 23.. As it is written: 'When you turn to the right or turn to the left, you will hear his voice behind you to guide you, saying 'This is the right path; follow it' " (Isa 30:21). Have you heard His still small voice? Seek Him and you will. Jer. 6:16; 1 Kings 17:45; 19:22; Ps. 85:8.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church.

Shalom.

item.title: Constructing the Golden Age on a Solid Rock
item.description: "Be sober-minded and watchful; stand firm in the faith; let all you do be done in love" (1 Corinthians 16:13).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Constructing the Golden Age on a Solid Rock on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Part 1

So, what's next? Well, the Golden Age for America is on the table now. Are its dreamers envisioning an expansive empire or an age of great social prosperity founded upon life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness? Time will tell the tale.

Blessed reader, the new executive orders now coming to bear upon America--those which were immediately signed following the recent inauguration and the promise of other governmental upgrades to come--are foundational accomplishments setting a tenor of hopeful expectation for our nation's restoration. Will the coming executive corrections (a) turn back our wobbly culture's spreading problems of lawlessness, social confliction, and governmental disorders--and (b) galvanize the building of the nation into a spiritual, moral, scientific, and financial bastion in the world? I would say the political, break-through steps of our new administration are proving effectual, and therefore it could easily be likened unto a political icebreaker--reminiscent of the heavy vessels of old which were reinforced with a strong and heavy bows that plowed into resistant artic ice flows and broke them up, thus allowing open passage to otherwise stifled maritime activity. In a similar manner, Trump is opening political passageways for social change. Though obstacles to restoration progress are being removed, some ask—is working to establish a golden age--a period of greatly amplified prosperity for our nation, a reasonable undertaking? Is it heaven sent, or the object of someone’s imagination? We do notice that the current changes are building excitement and stirring new vision for a profound resuscitation of the fading American Dream. Yet, there are two primary streams of vision emerging and both are needed to fulfill the hope of secular and spiritual restoration for the country. One is secular and involves the restoration of societal security, and profound, existential technological innovation. The other is spiritual and involves the restoration of full biblical truth and its incorporation into a conflicted institutional Ecclesia as the spiritual platform that can sustain a moral, liberty-friendly renewal. Both, working in their defined spheres can together bring beneficial changes to the country. But, on the other hand, can two unmixable visions of humane prosperity, if not properly related, produce favorable results. It's unlikely. After all, Scripture does contain this instruction --> "Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together" (Deut. 22:10). Why not, you ask? It is because they are physically unbalanced and could not plow a straight furrow together. Most significantly however, a careful look at Scripture reveals that any enterprise, large or small, must be constructed according to the instructions of the Messiah in order to resist institutionalism and endure the storms of life. See Matthew 7:24-27. Therefore, may we evaluate the matter of a national golden age and then decide for ourselves how our cultural recovery should be undertaken. But first, we should refresh our musing with another look at the Holy Spirit's sacred counsel posted above: "...let all you do be done in love" (1 Corinthians16:13). This would have to be the long term project's Prime Directive. It represents wisdom and thus welcomes the outstretched hand of Yahweh to assist and coordinate our labors to restore our nation on a foundation of stable biblical truth. Therefore, let's consider thoughtfully the transformation of America that is getting underway; what is transpiring in the land regarding the Golden Age vision, and where each one of us can fit in and become an active part of this great and exciting drama.

Bear in mind brethren, our new president in not in office by happenstance. He has been fore-ordained to occupy his high leadership position and is providentially set in place-while in good health, by divine intervention. He is thus the premier end-time player, so to speak. There are advantaged reasons why Yahweh wants to use our president and his administration. These favorable purposes include, for instance: (1) restoring our constitutional republic's culture and government, (2) elevating and preparing America for leadership during the turbulent times ahead, (3) supporting Israel for a season of peace, political unification, and Temple-building, (4) stabilizing other nations, and (5) moving Yahweh's prophetic, restoration timeclock forward--while this president remains in office. Therefore, we who support a spiritual and morally renewed and secured country with capable righteous leadership in place must pray daily for our president and his administrative team in order that Yahweh's purposes can indeed be fulfilled while he is in office. The LORD will do great things for us if we humble ourselves, repent, and follow His instructions of life. Consider what is written: "The reward for humility and fear of the LORD [devotion; piety] is riches, honor, and life" (Proverbs 22:4 NAS; Brackets C.V.). Amen!

Part 2

While building a golden age for the nation, the whole world is heading to a catastrophic end. Revelation 18-22. The Old Testament book of Daniel, chapter 7, speaks of the rise and fall of empires and directs our attention to the advent of the eternal Kingdom of the Most High which His holy people will inherit and indwell throughout eternity. How wonderful a prospect to be held before us! Meanwhile, the world is undergoing radical changes which are setting it up for the fulfillment of prophecy. Consider the seven seals of Revelation 6, for instance. The seals are historical and futuristic also. The first four seals describe the foremost spiritual forces that have accompanied and shaped history from the first century CE all the way to this point in time--which is most likely Seal 5. It references the blood of the martyrs. Note: We modern, western believes need to grasp what Christian life can be like in foreign nations. Thousands of Christians are killed for their faith each year, and more than 365 million Christians face extreme hostilities, persecution, imprisonment each year also. Further, abduction, sexual abuse, broken families, and destroyed homes are experienced regularly in hostile regimes. Please pray for those who live in restricted countries. Seal 6 follows and it appears to be a time of limited nuclear warfare and widespread societal turmoil — aka, NWO earthquakes. These events make necessary a multi-year period of widespread recovery and rebuilding to take place in preparation for the Antichrist. Enter Seal 7, noted for the 1/2 hour of silence occurring in heaven. According to the Kepha principle (2 Peter 3:8) -- this 30 minute quietude, we are told, translates into 20.67 years, which is an adequate time frame needed on earth for a new generation to be inculcated with Scientism's transhumanist propaganda, rebuilding war torn regions, cleaning up and burying the war debris, raising a temple in Israel, a NWO to arise and re-establish a global Artificial Intelligence grid, and create a entirely digitalized prison planet. That’s a lot. When the first Trumpet sounds the tribulation period as recorded in Revelation chapter 8 officially begins. The bowls of judgment come upon the planet after the seventh trumpet has been sounded as recorded in Revelation, chapter 11.

As we go to Part 2, keep in mind friends, that Contender's Voice is not founded to inform seekers and readers only, but to encourage all who visit us to develop friendship-faith in the risen Messiah, the fear of the Almighty, and a willing compliance to His Scriptures. These basic commitments will enhance your spiritual prosperity, peace, and bring joy into one’s life and service. Therefore, may all His saints seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness, and align their ambitions and life goals with His Holy Word and prophetic purposes. And secondly--may we hold up our constitutional republic as loyal patriots, and participate in its restoration and elevation. Conclusion: The Golden Age of America should be constructed upon the foundation of unabridged Scripture. Therefore, brethren, follow daily the sacred words of Messiah Yeshua which direct His followers to "seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness" (Mt. 6:33).

Conclusion

We live in an age marked by powerful, unrelenting evil forces--the hellish components producing spiritual and secular deception throughout the land. They are undergirded by the active and sentient spiritual wickedness of the second heaven that houses the highly organized, multitudinous dark empire of Satan. Do not dismiss this reality. Apostle John himself declared that the "...whole world lies in the power of the evil one" (1 John 5:19-20). Its rank and file are comprised of legions of fallen angels and multitudinous demons that relentlessly work to corrupt the minds of ignorant, unprotected people, and energize them for several nefarious purposes. They include (1) relentlessly opposing Yahweh's Gospel while luring believers into sinful lifestyles, (2) obfuscating Torah-based truth with false teaching, (3) causing the Ecclesia to avoid the Holy Spirit's full ministry, (4) disparaging biblical moral standards throughout the nations, (5) mocking holiness and righteousness, (6) disparaging the blessed truth about Yeshua--the divine Son, and His atonement, (7) causing mental and even physical disorders, and more. Ephesians 6:12. These beings comprise the unseen (usually) enemies of mankind. AI could turn out to be the fallen angelic empire's Trojan Horse on earth with Transhumanism as its wicked formal religion--for the beguiled ones who "...have been taken captive to do his will" (2 Timothy 2:26). Remember, as you come and go, wisdom will be given when a saint asks, so be glad dear contender. Wisdom and strong faith will be needed to accurately evaluate the possibilities and implications of building a golden age in America along side the restoration and guidance of Torah based values that are even now rising within the national Called-Out Assembly of Yeshua. Considering our current circumstances, what can a common American do to crossover from the oppressive dark dimension, leave it behind forever, cross over into the Savior's Kingdom of Light…and be miraculously transformed? Become an Eber, of course. It's our only wise choice. Contender's Voice will explain in our next post--Part 3, (a) what an Eber is, (b) the result and benefits of crossover, and (c) the three crucial steps for becoming an Eber. Let's meet soon at Part 3.

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

item.title: Enemies Within the Ranks
item.description: "Beware of false prophets. which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves" (Matthew 7:15).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Enemies Within the Ranks on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Jude -- Part 1

It is written in the Prophets: "Great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds..." (Jeremiah 32:19). The prophet informs his readers that Yahweh, our awesome, eternal Elohim and Creator, has purposes for mankind and accomplishes wonderful deeds in fulfilling them. And He gives each of His Kingdom people a purpose also, and deeds to accomplish as well while living on earth. These can draw a cooperating believer into a friendship-fellowship with the good Shepherd, the kind which father Abraham enjoyed. Such is a level of spiritual intimacy beyond that of a legal relationship. Do you, dear reader, know your primary purpose--your fundamental reason for which your Creator placed you on the earth in these latter days? Do you have deeds to fulfill on your pilgrimage? Your reason-for-being is actually twofold. Yeshua shares the answer which is found in the Deuteronomy 6:5 and Leviticus 19:18. It is written: "Thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it. Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself" (Mt. 22:34-40). These two commandments are His foundational instructions required of everyone who (1) aspires be a true disciple and devoted student of the Master, and (2) emulate His Spirit-led life among people. Following these commands fulfills all the instructions of the Torah and thus comprise "mighty deeds." Therefore, let's look into Jude's life of faith and be inspired to move forward in our own lives of faith, prophetic vision, and consecration. He demonstrated his love for God and neighbors by committing to preserve Yahweh's sacred Word amidst a flood of false teaching. So can we, blessed reader, also embrace a life of mighty deeds motivated by a the highest dual purpose a person can have. Such a person will be blessed!

Jude, our man of purpose, was a son of Joseph and Miriam and a half-brother of Yeshua, we are told. He was raised in Nazareth, Israel and identified himself as the "brother of James." In any case, Jude grew to become an experienced elder of the Nazarene sect of faith established by the apostles. He was a devout follower of Messiah Yeshua, and faithfully served among the apostolic, New Testament Nazarene disciples and converted saints. During his era (and afterwards as well) deceitful teachers and false apostles--dissemblers at heart, entered Nazarene gatherings and assaulted the doctrinal sanctity of the apostolic Ecclesia/Church. These doomed, "doubly dead" pretenders did so by (1) teaching deviant spiritual concepts and sophistries that contradicted its standing tenets, and thereby (2) attempting to dissuade members of the Nazarene sect from adhering to their holy faith and Yeshua, their Savior and King. The seduction campaign was, of course, satanically undergirded and effective! The groundless, anti-Messiah dogma of the false teachers included such aberrant fantasies as Gnosticism, Legalism (Judaizers), and Docetism (Yeshua was not human but celestial)--all of which were at variance with the divinely inspired, unmixed Old Covenant Scriptures. Simply put, these diabolical false teachers -- disguised religious wolves mingling amidst the sheep of the Good Shepherd, were attempting to discredit Messiah Yeshua's accurate Torah-based teachings which were diligently and contentedly followed by the original New Testament Nazarene assemblies. Their Torah doctrines and traditions were recognized to be God-given, entirely relevant, easy to bear, and hence had long been maintained in tact and kept in circulation. Nothing needed to be added to or taken away from their pristine tenets of faith which (a) comprised, (b) stabilized, and (c) enlivened their heavenly endorsed religious template. Modern believers are also being summoned today by the Spirit of Elohim for a great deed--that of recovering and persistently instructing the set-apart fold from the whole of Scripture--the Torah first, Old Covenant (Tanahk), and the New (Brit Hadashah)--without compromise. In this way truth guardians demonstrate love by fighting to preserve Yahweh's whole Word. Psalm 19:8; Matthew 11:30; 1 John 4:1; Jude 1:1-10-13.

Jude Part 2

"Contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to the saints" (Jude 1:3).

Jude was unrelenting. He recognized that the (a) deceitful teachers, (b) their twisting of Scripture, and (c) the bogus, misleading doctrines infiltrating the Nazarene faith community, called the "Way," posed an immediate existential threat to the doctrinal integrity and general welfare of the Nazarene Israelite assemblies. He therefore, in person and especially by way of his epistle, pleaded with the region's mature believers to stand firm in their apostolic beliefs, and expose and condemn the fraudulent teachers along with their infernal falsehoods. He commissioned them with the sober obligation to (1) defend--or contend for, the integrity of their faith's sacred beliefs and traditions which, as already stated, comprised the early Ecclesia's doctrinal framework. Vigorously contending for the "faith once for all entrusted to the saints" would (2) protect the spiritual stability of the threatened Nazarene congregations and their proclamation of pure, unalloyed salvation truth. The first century New Testament followers of Yeshua, who were primarily Judean Israelites, were thus placed under a solemn generational responsibility. They were called to resist the relentless intrusions of all false or compromised teachings and diligently strive to keep in place the holy faith--the fixed and unalterable Torah-based truth that had "once for all been entrusted" to [handed over to] the early apostles and followers of the Jewish Messiah. Jude 1:3; 1 Timothy 1:18-19; 6:12; Philippians 1:27. Jude understood the importance of the Torah's centrality to the Israelite Nazarene's faith and standards. It was, to the early disciples, the heaven-sent way of life and faith to embrace, guard, and openly proclaim. For instance, Contender's Voice contends for the truth in numerous ways, and one of them is by teaching that each person's salvation journey begins with the new spiritual birth experienced through faith in Messiah Yeshua, and following that miraculous encounter the saint should experience the the baptism with the Holy Spirit. In any case, dear saint, fill your life with mighty deeds motivated by love. You are equipped and destined to excel. See: Ephesians 2:8; Mt. 3:11 and Acts 1:8; 2:1-5)

Brackets-C.V.

Jude Part 3

" Go and make [Torah observant] disciples of all nations...teaching them all I have commanded you..." ( Mt. 28:19-20).

Jude's epistle, being recognized as divinely inspired, was acknowledged by the New Testament apostolic faith's leadership and incorporated into the Jewish Canon. The epistle was thereby officially secured as a timely and relevant reference by the end of the first century, C.E., though the exact date of composition is not known. In any case, the preserved ancient summons to expose and denounce false teaching, and defend the integrity of Yahweh's holy Word, has been applicable in every century. And today that summons to recover and guard Yahweh's unadulterated sacred truth is being quickened by the Holy Spirit and circulated again. It is still written: "...earnestly contend [fight, struggle; exert oneself to the utmost] for the faith [the words and way of life] once for all delivered unto the saints!" (Jude 1:3-4). Although many years have passed, the modern messianic Christian saints--those restoring Torah truth within their ranks and recapturing their Israelite identity, are also being invested with the same responsibility. Messianic believers are becoming spiritually aroused to unite around their restored Torah orthodoxy. This spiritual harmony will create a dynamic critical mass of fervent, outspoken New Testament contenders tasked with exposing, renouncing and leaving false and compromised teachings behind while restoring and proclaiming the un-compromised wholeness of Elohim's holy Torah-based Scriptures to an emerging new era Ecclesia. What do you think? Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

Be sure to post LIKE and subscribe. You will be notified of each weekly post. Thank you.

item.title: What’s Next?
item.description: Seek first the Kingdom of God
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of What’s Next? on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

America, we are being told, is destined to enter a new era, a Golden Age characterized by economic and technological global leadership. It would be a period of restored national law and order, financial prosperity, re-seated biblical morality, greatly advanced technology, and other gains that would bespeak of an expanded opportunity and contentment rising throughout our country. The presidential proclamation is definitely inspirational and very appealing because it is definitive and puts an attractive face and character on our country's collective hope for national culture renewal. The crusade of restoration won’t be easy, however. Such a grand and comprehensive campaign will require, for starters -- (1) a clear and sustained vision for a majority to endorse, (2) a moral upgrade restoring and elevating America's twentieth century ethos, (3) a committed, sustained public effort, and (4) providential guidance--for sure! This ambition is founded upon the necessity of satisfying the dire needs of our assailed country, its disgruntled and divided citizenry, and the spiritually compromised Ecclesia, which is Yeshua’s Called-Out Assembly—or westernized Christendom. To fulfill this purpose we-the-people cannot procrastinate. Rather, America must roll up its sleeves and go forward in (a) uplifting our new national goal and (b) demonstrating visionary leadership. For instance, initiative and an energetic proactive endeavor are required for gaining technological advancement. If enduring exertions are not employed, America will fall behind geopolitical "un-friendlies" who, in fact, will go forward and pass us up. But you might ask--what actually comprises a Golden Age. What will it be like, and who will be the architects, overseers, and financiers who develop its standards, manage the components, and administrate such an imposing venture? Further, could federal and state governments be politically maneuvered to cooperate with a Golden Age vision and remain united around the great national project. And, finally, is this Golden Age dream the will of our Creator? Time will tell. Remember to vote!

Some also wonder--what features will emerge in our own culture as this Golden Age vision goes forward. Well, some “thought-leaders” believe we can count on several components, good and not so good, to take form prominently during the cultural transition designed to make our nation even greater-than-great. First, a golden age for America will include a recovery–to some extent, of the traditional biblical religion and morality required to restore and sustain constitutional governmental stability. Secondly, there will be a rise of AI superiority accompanied by Transhumanism, a neo-pagan religion embraced by some, which envisions a science-based reboot of human evolution, genetic engineering , and preparation for a hybrid, post-human, robotic epoch. [This type of unprofitable spiritual adventurism was expounded during the last century by Dr. Timothy Leary, the LSD psychologist and advocate for psychedelic drugs who swooned the youth of that period.] Thirdly, our life experience will include total surveillance, travel restrictions, and cramped 15-Minute cities for the common people, to cite just a few social “advances” planned by a globalist elite and their appointed technocrats. Of course, a clear emphasis on Kingdom of God realities as revealed in the Scriptures, its Torah constitution, and biblical righteousness--spoken of by Yeshua, the crucified and resurrected Son of God--have yet to be clearly enunciated, or even suggested, as an integral feature of the plan. Frankly, I do not expect everything to be rosy during the upgrade of the culture. There will be shortcomings. Notwithstanding, let us not be discouraged over the prospect of lengthening dark shadows. Tares will grow with the wheat, Scripture informs us. Nevertheless, America has been given fresh, capable leadership that can correct many of our problems and “right” the left-listing national USS “Ship of State" from rolling over. [Think--Poseidon, the movie.] And we, His saints, will do well by praying daily for our newly elected leaders to honor His sacred Words and follow His lead and they legislate, plan and govern.

Maybe the Golden Age vision, as it develops under the leadership of righteous, trustworthy leaders and providential oversight, will in fact work out favorably for America—at least for while. If it is somehow kept to righteous standards it would provide beneficial and manifold improvements throughout our nation's social, economic, financial, and governmental realms. Nevertheless, we do not want to put all our eggs in that single basket! Any new kingdom age of multifaceted prosperity will not endure forever according to Daniel 2:31-46. We want to remember that, and ask ourselves-- how long could such a quasi utopian age actually last? Again, time will tell the tale. Meanwhile we must remember what Yeshua tells us in Matthew 7:24-27. "Whoever hears these sayings of Mine, and does them, I will reckon to a wise man who built his house upon a rock..." Our Redeemer’s building code clearly sets forth heaven’s standard of excellence for constructing a (1) good life and legacy, (2) fruitful ministries, a (3) stable constitutional republic...and even for initiating a (4) distinctive age as well. Keep in mind—obedience is the requirement of all Yeshua's instructions and the mainstay of one’s stability. Apart from His words, man's building efforts will not endure. However we might imagine the Golden Age to develop, one thing is true--Yahweh our Elohim keeps His promises. With that in mind, be sure to continue to pray, faithful readers—> “Thy Kingdom Come, thy will be done.” This prayer invokes the Almighty to bring forth His holy and glorious Kingdom destined to endure through the Age of Ages. Believers may support righteous political causes, but the Kingdom of God is that which the Savior’s followers --you and I, must prioritize!

Let's first prepare ourselves, dear saints, for what we read is next on the cosmic calendar regarding earth and the Messiah’s Ecclesia. Hence, with broad strokes I present an abbreviated thumb-nail sketch of what is prophesied in the Scripture for readers to consider. Let’s begin! There’s (1) the regathering of the scattered descendants of the “lost” ten tribes of Israel back to their Father’s House and His instructions; (2) the bride of Messiah [the Ecclesia] being prepared for her Groom; (3) the tribulation period and the second coming of Yeshua—we might be at the fifth seal; (4) the reunification of the houses Judah and Ephraim, and the restoration of the whole House of Israel; (5) the Millennial period of 1000 years of peace, with (6) the worldwide restoration of the Torah as the single constitution; (7) the creation of a new heavens and new earth, with the Golden New Jerusalem in place; and (8) the Age of ages. That’s a lot to envision. Hence, may we—Yahweh’s set-apart holy ones“…fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen” (2 Corinthians 4:18). The apostle exhorts the saints to not focus on the transitory things of this world but to concentrate on the glorious realities of eternal life with Yahweh that await. Thus, a Golden Age for the USA, one fit to serve and inspire the people, needs to be undergirded and engineered by the prime directive found in our Pledge of Allegiance. It’s the designated guiding principle that must be honored—“one nation under God, indivisible with liberty and justice for all,” must be revered.

In conclusion our often used closing words are “God bless America.” And He is faithful to respond. But what seems especially appropriate for this hour are these words: “America, bless God”. Amen

Next: The Kingdom of God and His Glory Now!

Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom

Be sure to press Like and Subscribe. Thank you.

item.title: Whose Words Should I Believe?
item.description: "The Word is near You" (Romans 10:8).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Whose Words Should I Believe? on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

A tsunami of written and broadcasted words, many of which contradict long standing, biblical foundations of truth, has been welcomed into our constitutional republic by America's undiscerning population. The flood is polluted, being mingled with what is beneficial to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness...and that which is not. Even so, the intrusion continues to infect, darken and disparage our national landscape. The once respected ethos of the country, the spiritual character of earlier years that served as a shield deflecting unseemly immoral intrusions from taking root in the culture, is broken down. And the nation's backsliding has welcomed forward the destructive intrusion of spiritual wickedness. Yet Yahweh's grace abounds still. The 2024 election has renewed the hope of many Americans that a spiritual awakening is rising in the land and the nation can yet be restored upon a re-constructed foundation of biblical faith and morality. But to assure the occurrence of such a wonderful spiritual restoration, isn’t it absolutely necessary for people to first believe truthful words and then faithfully adhere to them? Yes, of course it is!

"Faith comes by hearing, and hearing from the Word of God"( Rom. 10:17).

The Bible--from Genesis through Revelation, is one united book, not two separate ones as some assume. The New Covenant is best understood in the light of the Old Covenant. As you know, the Bible is comprised of 66 short books--39 in the O.T. and 27 in the N.T. But do you realize that Yeshua is revealed in various but distinct ways in each of the sixty-six books. This blessed set-apart book, in which Messiah Yeshua is the central figure, is estimated to have been printed 5 to 7 billion times. In addition, 100 million copies are printed each year and find their way into the hands of as many people. It is an annual best seller and the most gifted text, as well. Conclusion: The Bible is by far the most purchased and circulated publication of all time. Nothing else comes close. Why? It's simple. Biblical truth is divinely anointed and carries the most powerful and important words ever spoken or printed on earth. Scripture’s Kingdom of God proclamation is founded upon the virtue of love and therefore its penetrating truth has broken down evil strongholds to alter history by consistently having a profound beneficial influence upon the nations it has visited. Indeed, the sacred Scriptures have favorably impacted--in greater or lesser measures, many nations around the world, and continues to bear a strong influence everywhere the Bible is opened.

The Torah-based Scriptures provide unerring knowledge of—(a) God (Yahweh Elohim), (b) redemption and salvation by faith in the Son—Yeshua, (c) the ministry of the Holy Spirit, (d) instruction for a set-apart, blessed personal and corporate life, (e) prophetic vision for the future, and much more. In comparison to the nearly 7 billion printed copies of the Bible, the Quran is listed at 800 million printed copies…but possibly more. And the Book of Mormon, another comparison, is listed as having 120 million copies printed and in use. Interestingly, the Bible is not only the most printed and read book on earth, it the most stolen book in the world also. Are you surprised? Who on earth would steal the Scriptures, you might ask? A lot of spiritually hungry and needy people apparently! For instance, consider the Gideon Bibles. These wonderful, famous Bibles were once found in most Motel rooms around the nation. They were quality publications that clearly proclaimed the Gospel and salvation by faith in Messiah Yeshua, provided wisdom and comfort for many tired travelers, particularly in the twentieth century. Did you ever leave a motel with one of the Gideon holy books in your suitcase? These Bibles, so prominent during the decades that are long gone, helped sustain the Christian ethos of our nation. Indeed, words do sculpt the thinking of people and nations. So, may we be wise in regarding what words we must esteem and imbibe.

To refuse the written Word of God, which is in close proximity to westerners, is inexcusable. It has been translated and printed in just about every language, and made available to all the nations of the planet. YHWH has graciously provided the opportunity for men and women everywhere, especially in the west, to hear His salvation message and perceive His mercy and love for mankind that were revealed in the sacrifice of His Son, Messiah Yeshua. It is therefore up to people everywhere to listen and avail themselves of the message. To hear (or hearken) means to receive the Word of God in such a way that the hearer is disposed to believe it and obey. The Father sends forth his unmixed, pure Word without any intention to burden people with numerous obligations and chores. He loves us, each and every one, and therefore desires to provide and enlighten the way to liberty, to bring forth prosperity of soul, draw us into greater spiritual intimacy with Himself--and establish a close fellowship of which the believer can be joyfully cognizant. Therefore, hearken closely to Yahweh's words, for all of them have been recorded for your enrichment and salvation, dear reader. It is written for us: "For I know the plans that I have for you, declares the LORD, plans for welfare and not for calamity, to give you a future and a hope" (Jeremiah 29:11). Dear reader, (a) trust for His goodness to reside in your life, and (b) make sure His sacred words--beginning with the Torah, are always welcomed to lodge in your heart. Amen! Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Shalom. Hutch Church.

Be sure to subscribe. By doing so you will be notified each week when a new restoration has been posted. Shalom.

item.description: "If the foundations [of biblical truth] be destroyed [rejected], what can the righteous do?" Psalm 11:3).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Recover the Foundation-Torah! on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Have you, dear reader, become spiritually desensitized by a lifetime of abiding in America's "Me First" culture, or by imbibing modern Christendom's frail, Torah-less spirituality? Our tattered culture--generally speaking, is characterized by the (a) exaltation of self, (b) prioritizing one's own interests above those of others, (c) the insatiable drive for accumulating wealth and prestige, (d) the dominance of immorality, (e) the evolution of "wokeness" and (f) manifold idolatry--to cite just a few common devastating failures. These malevolent sores arose from a culture that has been left unenlightened and unprotected by a moribund Christian "salt and light" ministry. Our changing culture is also bereft of expressing gratitude for the granted blessings of Providence that, by His grace, tenuously remain upon our country. We should not be surprised because this has been prophesied to occur. Hear His Word, readers: "But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days. People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud...having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with them" (2 Timothy 3:1-5). Yet, won't there come a "just-in-time" world-wide revival as many proclaim, you ask? I don't see the advent of such a wonderful phenomenon clearly proclaimed in the Scriptures. What's more, studies and polls indicate a significant measure of the American people have not repented of their sinfulness while the unsettled country continues to face rising internal and external challenges that will extend through 2025 and beyond. But I do think a significant revival of biblical Spirit and Torah truth is possible if enough of Yahweh's people can sincerely follow the full set of instructions recorded in 2 Chronicles 7:14. So, "...what can the righteous do do?" We can continue to recover and securely reset the Torah as the biblical cornerstone of our varied faith orthodoxies. But first of all we must boldly apply--without hesitation or sheepishness, its foundational instructions to our personal lives and then firmly establish them as the doctrinal base in our religious assemblies. [Note: New wineskins can be put in place if necessary.] In any case, it is past time for the Ecclesia to begin conforming to the Torah's applicable and doable truth. It comprises the sacred words of the Father--which Messiah Yeshua, His divine Son and our Savior, perfectly upheld and faithfully taught. Think about the Torah as being the (a) fertile starting point of all Scripture and (b) the foundation prescribed for building blessed and fruit-bearing lives and legacies. Matthew 7:24-27. Though His sheep face difficulties at every level, His assurance is comforting. It is by "...tribulation that we enter the kingdom" (Acts 14:22). And by the struggles allowed into our lives we experience in greater measure (1) the Father's love, (2) the compassion of the eternal Son, Yeshua, and (3) the comfort and peace of the Holy Spirit. Therefore faithful brethren, even in your challenges keep to the Narrow Road pointed out by the Messiah that leads to everlasting life. For that end, remain courageous, stay strong in demonstrating faith and love--especially when doing so is difficult, and fear not! Your (a) growth in grace (b) spiritual enrichment of your soul, and (c) "...the glory that is to be revealed to us" following the earthly trials that come and go throughout life--are assured blessings, and their fulfillment is beyond cavil. See Romans 8:18. Therefore, beloved readers, "...let the Word of Messiah dwell in you richly" and know that you are blessed!

"Faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God" (Romans 10:17).

To refuse the Word of God is inexcusable. By much effort it has been sent into all the world and communicated in just about every language on the planet. YHWH has graciously provided the opportunity for men and women everywhere to hear His salvation truth, and it is therefore up to people to listen and avail themselves of the message.To hear (or hearken) means to receive the Word of God in such a way that the hearer is disposed to believe and obey. When the Father sends forth his unmixed, pure Word, He does not intend to burden us with numerous obligations and chores. He loves us, each and every one, and therefore desires to provide and enlighten the way to liberty, to bring forth prosperity of soul, and draw us into greater spiritual intimacy with Himself, a close fellowship of which you can be cognizant. Hearken closely to what is written for us: "For I know the plans that I have for you, declares the LORD, plans for welfare and not for calamity, to give you a future and a hope" (Jeremiah 29:11). Dear reader, trust for His goodness to make its way to your tent this week. Amen! Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Shalom. Hutch Church.

item.title: Heartfelt Obedience is Pure Worship and a Weapon
item.description: "He who obeys instructions guards his life, but he who is contemptuous of his ways will die" (Proverbs 19:16).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Heartfelt Obedience is Pure Worship and a Weapon on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

The recent presidential election has brightened the latent hope long held by many anxious, discontented Americans who have desired a spiritual and moral awakening to occur across the nation and that a much needed social recovery would follow in its wake. Two fundamental requirements, however, for achieving a healthy and enduring social renewal and the dismantling of the government's unaccountable bureaucratic deepstate, are essential: First--there must be a notable renewal of biblical piety among the populace, which would very likely take place in the context of a sweeping religious revival. Secondly, fully mending and bolstering a stable, prudent and fair-minded constitutional republic can only be accomplished by repairing it upon the ethics of a biblically-based faith foundation. This is a very tall order, for sure! Nevertheless, upon such an unassailable footing the reassertion of our challenged constitutional republic and the procedural realignments needed in the three compromised branches of our federal government, can actually--election by election, take place. These broad steps could (a) initiate further social corrections and (2) prove the wisdom of Scripture and verify the words of the Savior recorded in Matthew 7:24-28. Keep this crucial reality in mind also. An enduring domestic restoration, which modern faith reformers envision, is possible. However, the evil spiritual component that (1) undergirds the nation's spiritual, moral, and secular lawlessness, (2) opposes Yahweh's Gospel, and (3) energizes its ungodly and reprobate human constituents--must be identified, cast out, and replaced with the original supporting pillars of Torah-rooted truth. How? This can be done if informal pockets of believers along with organized groups of a spiritually awakened Ecclesia can unite and pray, and in so doing become transformed into obedient followers of Yahweh's instructions. Wholehearted compliance with His commandments amounts to pure worship. Furthermore, un-compromised obedience is also a powerful force, a weapon of spiritual warfare just as is praying in the Spirit. In any case, if the followers of Yeshua are going to fulfill their spiritual potential and destiny then humble obedience must become the bedrock from which their individual and corporate prayer, praise, and worship, and service rise heavenward. Such open adorations will (1) glorify Yahweh our Elohim, (2) uplift the participants, and (3) drive away the presence, power, and influence of malevolent spiritual forces of wickedness. Ephesian 6:12. Remember what has been written for you, dear reader: "Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken [to His Scripture] than the fat of rams [religious routine]" (1 Samuel 15:22). Conformance to divine instructions is the response the Father has always desired of His people. Tell us your opinion.

We can be glad, brethren, for the evidence of divine grace is already at play and beginning to anoint America's wounds with holy oil and also satisfy the nation's dire need of spiritual and moral resuscitation. For instance, the hints of revival are mounting and are encouraging reformation advocates, like you and me, to continue forward in Torah based faith restorations despite the naysayers. Consider for example: (a) the growing number of young people who are coming to faith in Messiah Yeshua and getting baptized; (b) the prayer meetings that are spreading and beginning to impact the nation; (c) the occurrence of personal repentance is becoming more prevalent along with the realization of the need for personal holiness; (d) the interest in the unabridged, pure Word of Elohim--the Torah, is continuing to grow while Bible sales are increasing significantly at the same time. This spiritual resurgence is becoming greater as I write. Furthermore, the uprising of salvation faith is (e) stirring zeal among converts to the Gospel of Yeshua to become true, Spirit-filled disciples who want to earnestly study the Father's sacred Scriptures. This spiritual awakening is a Hebraic oriented, Torah restoration phenomenon inspired and led by the Holy Spirit! In fact, it is a manifold national movement prophetically timed for equipping a new generation of saints for service in these latter days of upheaval and radical national and even geo-political change. But despite its merits it is often besmirched and ridiculed by misinformed people, particularly those associated with westernized Christianity. Notwithstanding, the Hebraic emphasis upon the Torah, the Sabbath and Yah's moedim appointments, and personal sanctification is inspiring new disciples of Yeshua to conform to His mitzvot (commands)--all that are known and understood, relevant to the individuals, and doable. Another encouragement for His people to continue in prayer and faith is (f) the presence of the Holy Spirit being recorded as moving in miraculous ways in meetings and evangelistic crusades being held by the Messiah Yeshua's followers. Yes, there's much going on for which contenders/guardians for Yahweh's whole truth can be glad. Therefore, let's press forward and expect good things to unfold for ourselves and others as well, amidst the rising infernal turbulence set in motion by the earth's reprobate rulers, world forces of darkness, and damned spiritual powers "...for whom the black darkness has been reserved forever" (Jude 1:13). Acts 1, 2, and 3.

Finally, ponder the life of Abraham, who "believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness--and he was called a friend of God" (James 2:23). He is referred to as a friend of Yahweh to this day because he followed the Creator's commandments exactly and without complaint. Hence, he is also called the believers' spiritual father, as you know. And remember--Yahweh's words have power and the ability to change our hearts, minds, and will. Hear His simple, straightforward word of affirmation for us: "...blessed are those who hear the word of God and observe it" (Luke 11:28) Remember blessed Abraham and follow in his faith-footsteps. Conclusion: Obedience glorifies Yahweh, transforms believers, and vanquishes the powers of darkness. So, for many reasons become a close and conversant friend of God’s and rejoice! You have been set apart, blessed disciple, and will be known for your good works. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Shalom. Hutch Church.

Would you like to know what believe and deny mean? In part two of this post, which is coming up, you will find out! And keep in mind the four levels of Hebraic interpretation of the holy Scriptures.
