item.title: Greatest and Least of Commandments
item.description: "Blessed are those who hear the Word of God and observe [obey] it" (Luke 11:28).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Greatest and Least of Commandments on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Yeshua's dedicated followers are distinguished by their (a) separation from following worldly ideologies, circular philosophies, New Age beliefs, and faulty moral standards and their (b) compliance instead to His instructions and teachings alone. Indeed, may all His followers be spiritually elevated by becoming genuine disciples who hear His commands with wise and submitted hearts. Yet the question arises: Which of Elohim's commandments do we obey for there are many. That's true. The Torah contains hundreds of moral, ceremonial, civil and national laws. Someone may therefore think that obeying the greatest laws is more important that striving to honor the least of the laws. But is that so? The greatest law, according the our Torah teacher, Yeshua, is found in Deuteronomy 6: 5, where it is written: "You shall love the LORD you God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength." This command is foremost and well known. It is accomplished by love-motivated believers obeying His instructions--all that are known to them, understood, applicable, and doable. That would be the starting point, so to speak. But what about the lesser known laws in the Torah? Are they important as well? Yes, they are! All God's laws reflect His sublime, holy character and agape love for His creation and all those abiding within it. So let's examine a couple of the lesser known laws and discover that their purpose is connected to honoring YHWH and even loving our neighbor, as are the better known ones. Leviticus 19:18. John 14:15-21.

"If you happen to come upon a bird's nest along the way...you shall not take the mother with the young, but the young you may take...in order that it may be well with you and that you may prolong your days" (22: 6-7).

The Jewish commentator Rambam cited two reasons for this unusual prohibition: (1) It is cruel to kill a mother and its young together, on the same day (Lev. 22:28). (2) The statute implied that Israelites must be restrained from endangering any species of animals, which could happen if there were no restrictions on slaughtering a mother animal with its young. Contender's Voice adds: (3) The female sex makes motherhood and the propagation of young possible, and binds one generation to the next. Thus, the command to spare the mother bird is significant, for the principle conveys the same consideration to other species of animals, and also accentuates the verse (v. 5) it follows concerning differentiating between the sexes. (4) The mother was spared for a purely practical reason: because the female is needed for continuing the propagation [increase in numbers] of birds, and maintaining their population. Birds were needed! They kept down bugs, insects, and grubs, and even helped pollinate the fields. (5) The statute, which rendered motherhood sacred in the woods, helped remind Israel how much more should motherhood be sacred in the nation. A mother should be honored by her children. To the perceptive, the seemingly insignificant law taught that the young should bear the burdens, not the old. (6) Then, there is the law prohibiting boiling (seething) a kid in its mother's milk, that is thrice repeated in Scripture, and relates to the "nest" statute. See: Exodus 23:19; 34:26, and Deut. 14:21.

The three-fold repetition of the law indicates its importance in helping to keep awake the sense of propriety and respect for life in the soul of the nation. There are various explanations for this statute, but upon this there is agreement: It is "...a protest against cruelty, and outraging [of] the order of nature, more especially the peculiarly sacred portion of nature's order, the tender relation between parent and child, mother and suckling. No doubt the practice existed. [Goat] kids were thought more palatable [tasty] when boiled in milk; and the mother's milk was the readiest to obtain. But in this way the mother was made sort of [an] accomplice in the death of her [young], which men were induced to kill on account of the flavor that her milk gave it...but feeling revolts from it, and [so does] the general sense of civilized mankind..." Eerdmans, Book of the Covenant, p. 203. (7) The statute carried with it an incentive, a great promise, similar to that of the fifth commandment: "Thou shalt honor thy father and thy mother, that your days may be prolonged in the land..." (Ex. 20:12).

How could this be, you might think? How could a longer life result from honoring the "nest" commandment? A. It is the duty of the saints to cultivate kindness toward all things. The statute brought attention to this principle. See Gal. 5:22-25. "A righteous man has regard for the life of his animal" (Prov. 12:10). B. This practice will always produce a pronounced, uplifting effect on a person's character and leaven his life with greater sweetness. C. After all, the man/woman [family] who shows mercy will receive mercy (Mt. 5:7). D. So it will also be with the influenced society that practices justice with mercy. Where mercy and kindness are universally esteemed and nurtured, Yahweh's approval and blessing will be manifest. E. Elohim blesses obedience, whether or not the ramifications of His ordinances are fully understood. (8) Thus, the commandment to spare the mother provoked thoughtfulness, and as it was obeyed, offered the potential of developing those positive individual and community sympathies that lend themselves to elevated social morality, quality of living, and thereby a longer, healthier life. What may have seemed a small thing was actually a big thing. The great artist Michaelangelo, who was a Believer, once commented: "Trifles make perfection." Better than that, Yeshua said, "Not the smallest letter or stroke shall pass from the Law until all is accomplished" (Mt. 5:18). All the commandments have significance.

Here's another commandment! "...You shall make a parapet for your roof..." (Deut. 22:8).

Here is an example of a practical social mitzvah [single law]. Liabilities and potential hazards, indeed—anything that presented a threat to life and health, waas to be removed or corrected in a Hebrew home to make it comfortable and safe. Parapets were particularly important for preventing visitors who slept on roof tops from rolling off and plummeting to the ground. The idea behind the guidelines concerning houses, vineyards, plowing, and garment materials was to show Israel that YHVH's people must be distinguished in their lives and work by exhibiting quality, thoughtfulness, honesty, wisdom, and thoroughness. And consider this sobering verse: "Not everyone who says to Me 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven" (Mt. 7:21). Selah!

Deuteronomy 22: 9-11 emphasizes the distinction in nature that YHVH made in His creation and that the mixing or blending of distinct things was not sanctioned. There were practical and spiritual reasons for these restrictions. An ox and a donkey were fine for husbandry but ill-suited to plow together. To yoke them, being of differing size, strength, and temperament, would be stressful for them and thus cruel. Sowing different types of seed together tended to produce weaker and fewer crops. Linen and wool were used together in certain pagan superstitious customs, and was thus forbidden. [There are other interesting health reasons. Do some research.] Also, when washed and dried they tended to pull away from one-another. The lesson all this teaches is that YHVH's boundaries must be guarded, and hybridization was to be avoided, especially in the realm of faith. Consider Genesis 6:1-8. Further, the House of Ephraim was exiled and scattered to the nations for hybrid worship--mixing unholy pagan customs with fragments of Torah truth. And, Scripture tells us that Believers should not be yoked with unbelievers. YHVH says, "Can two walk together unless they agree?" (Amos 3:3). His commandments guide and protect. Be glad. The Torah proves the heavenly Father (Abba) loves you.

Conclusion: Elevate Yeshua and place His words above all else. Establish His instructions as central to your life, and ambitions, decisions, and behavior. Love Him. Completely. We've had ample time to pray and repent yet, despite the recent election, spiritual darkness has not yet lifted. It's time to prepare as darkness could still intensify and even restrict free speech and the expression of biblical faith. And grasp this reality, dear reader--heart-felt obedience to His sacred Word is the biblical expression of (a) love, (b) faith, and (c) pure worship. I will see you at the next post. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

item.title: Life is Duty
item.description: Part 1
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Life is Duty on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Purpose: To compare the U.S. Marine Corps--and its knowledge of and conformance to the (a) Code of Conduct [ethics] based upon the (b) Uniform Code of Military Justice with the modern, westernized Ecclesia and its knowledge of and conformance to (a) the holy Scriptures--based upon (b ) the Law and the Prophets.

"Everyone should submit to the governing authorities, as there is no authority except that which God has established" (Rom. 13:1).

In September, 1965, I stepped down from a Greyhound bus at the notorious Parris Island Marine Corps Recruit Depot in South Carolina. And behold! I was immediately greeted by a very large yellow sign with bold red lettering on it. So too were the other wide-eyed recruits who accompanied me. The sober wording declared: "The Marine Corps demands Discipline, Devotion to Duty, and Teamwork." The words requests, please, and thank you were conspicuously absent. Hence, I saw this in-your-face "hello" not merely as a (1) strong recommendation, but for what is really was--a (2) foreboding, Old Corps prime directive to be taken literally and very seriously. At that time I had no idea that the Marine Corps' espoused basic standards for recruits were compatible with Scripture's requirements for aspiring disciples of Yeshua. See Matthew 16:24. Anyway, the unfriendly introduction caused my apprehension level concerning the future to spike! This took place during the days of the unforgiving Old Corps, with its stifling wooden barracks, biting sand fleas, heavy M-14 rifles, and other unpleasantries. Yet, by bearing the burdens of discipline, recruits learned to understand and respect the important role of duty in life.

Obedience to Holy Scripture is the Biblical Expression of Love, Faith, and Worship.

Nevertheless, having been (a) deposited on the inhospitable island--a place from which no recruits had ever successfully escaped, and my (b) vowed commitment to military service being irreversible, I took the large, intimidating red words to heart and went forward mentally prepared to comply with the austere demands of the new chapter of life I had chosen. But unknown to me, my forbearance with the Corps' dominance--and the subsequent rigors of Vietnam, initiated a gradual inner transformation that would contribute to conditioning me years later for a life-changing encounter with the Holy Spirit, and conversion to the Messiah. Beforehand however, I learned quickly how serious the Corps really was concerning its posted fundamental requirements. The yellow sign's stern message was indeed inflexible and vigorously enforced, as if it had been "etched in stone." There was no mincing of words; no equivocation! The matter was settled and there would be no "about face." Recruits-all who had vowed loyalty to the constitution and the service, would (a) learn and (b) march in cadence to ALL the Corps pertinent regulations and fulfill their duties in a satisfactory fashion! Failure of a Marine to obey a lawful order or regulation is a violation of Article 92 of the Uniform Code of Military Justice. This arrogance is called "Dereliction of Duty" and punishment is closely associated with it. Ignorance of the law is no excuse. Do you, friend, observe overt derelictions among the saints in knowing but not keeping the instructions of the Most High Elohim? I think most of us fall short of expectations from time to time, but some who profess Yeshua as Messiah choose to live outside His teaching.

"Why do you call Me 'Lord, Lord' and do not what I say?"(Luke 6:46).

It is normal that military inductees, both men and women, relate to the particular branch of service to which they are legally bonded, and remain loyal to its Code of Conduct. Disciples of Messiah Yeshua, on the other hand, identify themselves with a divine Person --their resurrected Savior, His Kingdom, and Elohim's sacred Law--His heavenly instructions for a blessed, worshipful life . To Him belongs their first loyalty. John 6:63. The apostle Paul affirmed and lived this faith-bond, and wrote: "But whatever things were gain to me, those things I have counted as loss for the sake of Messiah" (Phil. 3:7). Yet there are people who claim salvation through faith in Yeshua but do not care to develop a bond of close fellowship with Him or His instructions. These casual saints want liberty from the Law of the Almighty, preferring carnal license and worldly pursuits instead. They are not disciples or servants of the Savior. The Kingdom of God cannot be separated from its Sovereign and His holy standards. To be in the kingdom now is to live by His teaching now! Not later. As it is written: "By this we know that we have come to [truly] know Him, if we keep His commandments." See 1 John 2.:3-6. Plain and simple, yes? Yet western saints, it seems, become easily fascinated by secondary interests and spiritual diversions other than the study of Yahweh's testimony and conformance to the life-changing words of Scripture inspired by the Holy Spirit. And what's more, few choose to become actual disciples of the Savior. A costly blunder, indeed.

Though the bullseye--the centrality of the Torah has been made clear, many are still missing the mark. In this era of cultural decomposition rooted in misinformation and spiritual wickedness, Yahweh is meeting a great need of our confused westernized Ecclesia. By His grace common believers are being led by the Spirit of Truth (John 16:13) back to the Father's House, the Torah and sacred Law. This is a tremendous gift of love. His instructions for a holy and productive life, when honored, lead followers to an overcoming life and the resurrection of the righteous. This love-induced trove marks the terminus of our earthly search for pure, entirely reliable spiritual truth. What do you think, dear reader? We have been given orders, holy instructions to respect and follow--just as have the Marines. But (a) can we, Spirit-born believers in Yeshua compare favorably in honoring--or even knowing and believing, the full measure of our Scripture's instructions as faithfully (b) as the Marines know, respect and conform to their General Orders and the Code of Military Justice? I think I know the answer. In any case, we have not been saved by keeping Yahweh's laws and instructions...we are regenerated by the Holy Spirit and saved to keep them—as would be expected of true disciples of righteousness. Jer. 31:31-33; Ezek. 36:24-27.

The recent presidential election—a wonderful demonstration of our Elohim’s grace, pushed back the advance of cultural progressivism, turned away reprobate leadership, exposed the debauched nature of wokism, and provided hope for the majority of Americans who want real change in the nation. Most of them sincerely desire a broad spiritual awakening to occur and a reset of the country’s political, secular, and spiritual institutions, upon foundations of fundamental biblical doctrines. This inspiring hope is very rich and much needed in our conflated, spiritually unraveling nation. I agree with those who believe this hope is going to be vindicated. Still, the core of an enduring revival can remain heated, and even elevated to higher levels of Spirit and Truth manifestation not experienced before, if founded upon a critical mass of charged, unassailable truth. Simply, revival faith-foundations must be anchored upon the unblemished, Torah-based words of Messiah Yeshua. Selah! Matthew 7:24-27.

Part 2 of Life is Duty-Five Common Values--is next. It continues with our analogy--i.e., comparing the Marine Corps ethos with the developing character of the westernized Body of Messiah--the Ecclesia/Church. Faith challenges and heart recalibrations may await us there. Following Part 2 are Parts 3 through 8, making this presentation long for blogging. Therefore I recommend that interested readers go to: contendersvoice.com. Start with the Illustration and scroll down to Complementary Readings; Group Three: Honor and Guard Full Truth. There you will find the whole “Life is Duty” parts 1-8. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Shalom.

Contender's Voice is the current outreach. It is our restoration ministry made available on line. Thank You for reading our presentation. Shalom. Hutch Church.

item.description: "Unless the LORD is the foundation [unless His Mt. 7:24-27 building code for life and ministry is followed], the Building won't stand..." (see Psalm 127).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Guard your Faith's Integrity on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Alert! “Beware of false prophets [misleading proclaimers and teachers] who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves” (Mt. 7:15). Keep in mind, reader—they are generational and ubiquitous. So remain watchful and discerning. The verse pertains to this hour as much as it did centuries ago. Hence, let’s look at spiritual “guardianship.”

Following the ascension of our resurrected Savior, committed Nazarene Torah disciples of His—mature men who were elders of the original, New Covenant Nazarene faith—were enlisted by an assembly overseer named Jude to satisfy a dire need. They were instructed by this Jewish Nazarene leader to guard Yahweh's sacred truth from demonized false teachers who traveled about maligning the person and teachings of Messiah Yeshua, and attempting to mislead the immature saints away from His Gospel to their doctrine of salvation by works, not faith. These loyal Nazarenes, being enlisted as “Gospel guardians,” were tasked with the distinct responsibility of courageously and openly opposing false prophets and errant teachers by implementing the timely ancient entreaty (plea) recorded in Jude's epistle during the early apostolic era. It was a restoration directive actually, written and circulated to the Nazarene saints of old whose faith community and its uncontaminated orthodoxy were being regularly troubled by the entry of antinomian, heretical teachers. These vain pedagogues were wicked men who taught a perverted grace doctrine and rejected the sovereignty and true nature of Israel's Messiah. Hence, the strong and widespread appeal to the Nazarene disciples to guard the pure faith handed down to them by Yahweh is straight-forward and reads: "...earnestly contend for the faith once for all delivered to the saints" (Jude 1:3). This was not a mere suggestion—it was an ardent instruction. Truth be told, Jude’s directive was not only an urgent summons, it indeed carried the authority of a biblical injunction. And what's more, it proved to be a wise, well-timed, resuscitative decree that served to (1) guard the Nazarene’s pure orthodoxy from the entry of flawed teaching prominent among the various heretical sects, (2) maintain peace and order in the assembly, and (3) encourage the apostolic saints and converts whose faith and hope were teetering under the onslaught of anti-messiah teaching and persecution. See 2 Timothy 4:1; John 1:1-14.

This same kind of theosophic, new age, spiritual skulduggery is being used today by reprobate religionists to render the Word of Elohim obscure, misunderstood, and/or unintelligible! Because the saints do not study the Word of God under the tutelage of the Holy Spirit, or obey it, many Christians are spiritually apathetic, undiscerning, and easily deceived as they walk contentedly on the broad road warned of by the Messiah. This lamentable condition runs rampant throughout America. Therefore, the entry of persistent false teaching and deceptive New Age ideologies has been woven into Christendom's orthodoxies and even the national mindset. The invasion of spiritual deception has continued for centuries and is accelerating in our nation today, to the extent that in fact we find ourselves under a country-wide demonic spell. Therefore, rebuilding true Torah-based faith foundations on His words, at least by a remnant of "crossover" New Wine saints, is absolutely required for maintaining and nurturing a long-term spiritual awakening and recovery. Thus, (1) recovering, (2) proclaiming, and (3) guarding the original, apostolic standard of the original, divinely sanctioned Torah-based faith to modern disciples of Messiah is an important objective of Contender's Voice.

Conclusion

Dear visitor, Contender's Voice encourages you to take time to examine all the menu's material and resources. In particular, you are invited to inspect the parsha-oriented (1) Torah Discipleship and (2) Torah Commentary one-year courses. And be sure to look over the website's brief teachings that reinforce our prophetic restoration vision and comprise our blog ministry. Check it all out! But remember—hold on to the way of the Bereans: First, study the Scriptures faithfully under the tutelage of the Holy Spirit. Secondly, prayerfully evaluate everything you read on this site (and others) by comparing it with Yahweh's Word. Thirdly, decide for yourself the validity of the content. Finally, blessed reader, endeavor to guard and fully comply with the truth that (a) Yahweh has made known to you, (b) is applicable to you, and (c) is understood and doable by you. In this way you will be blessed in all your righteous endeavors. You are needed. Here's your personal promise: "For the LORD is a sun and a shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor. No good thing will He withhold from those who walk uprightly" (Psalm 18:11). Thank you for visiting us. And be sure to establish your Torah-rooted faith convictions in your heart…and continue to vigorously CONTEND for them! They will be challenged. Remember, our fellowship with the unadulterated, sacred words of Yahweh our Elohim determines (a) the quality our lives, (b) the character and value of our spiritual legacies, and (c) our ultimate destinies. item.title: Follow Yeshua's Instructions.
item.description: "Study to show yourself approved unto God..." (2 Tim. 2:15).
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Follow Yeshua's Instructions. on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Contender's Voice ministry encourages all readers to take upon themselves (1) a commitment to re-study the Scriptures and (2) a faithful adherence to the ancient paths of YHWH, i.e., the instructions of the Torah. Such a reasonable dedication is necessary for living profitably before Yahweh and growing in His grace and truth. It is the "good way" which Yeshua, His apostles and disciples, and Paul with his companions, followed. [Remember-Paul never regarded himself as a Christian, nor was he ever addressed as such. He was a Nazarene, Spirit-filled believer of the sect called “the Way.”] In any case the ancient paths of Israel must be the ways of life to which modern disciples of the Messiah adhere also! Toward that end, Contender's Voice envisions a heaven-sent, spiritual and moral awakening that draws multitudes to His unabridged, pure, divinely inspired Torah. This would result in a great spiritual "comeback" of significant dimensions occurring throughout America's darkened secular and spiritual realms. You can be sure that a phenomenon of this nature is absolutely necessary for restoring the country's confused and weakened Ecclesia and, in turn, re-stabilizing our bewildered and conflicted nation, America.

Christianity is a hybrid, or syncretist, religion. It is absolutely colossal in scope, even global in size and varied, having been influenced by and blended with unbiblical beliefs and practices. Thus, some of its orthodoxy is compromised. Actually Christianity—primarily Catholicism and Protestantism, grew from being an offshoot of the original Hebraic-oriented faith of the apostolic Nazarenes, whose sect was referenced as “The Way.” Nevertheless, its diverse organizations can adhere to enough common basic biblical "salt and light"standards to uphold and enlighten, to some extent anyway, a darkened society.—like ours. But ignorance of Yahweh's Torah, the solid foundation of Holy Writ, has left Christendom spiritually weakened by its ongoing oversight of (1) Yahweh's sacred instructions and the spiritual vitality associated with them. Another widespread shortfall I want to mention is (2) the neglected teaching of most churches concerning Yeshua's baptism with the Holy Spirit. One more blunder whole denominations make is teaching the false doctrine of Cessationism. This serious error proclaims that the miraculous gifts of the Holy Spirit- though needed today as much as ever, no longer function through believers. However, Contender’s Voice refutes this pitiful error and indeed, definitely supports the full ministry of the Holy Spirit. Selah--what do you think about that? I think we saints need to humble ourselves, repent of all wickedness, be Spirit-led, and start conforming to the holy words of our divine, soon coming King. 1 Corinthians 12.

Keep in mind, dear reader, that Contender's Voice is hebraically oriented. We do not unfairly criticize anyone's religion or traditions, but rather attempt to teach from an Israelite, Torah based perspective. Hence Contender's Voice recommends that all readers think for themselves as they read, and to check out our material with what is written in the Scriptures. Further, we proclaim the Sabbath-keeping Yeshua and not the westernized version of Him who is referenced as Jesus and not by His Hebrew name. Nor do we promote all of the holidays that institutional Christianity continues to practice. This ministry will remind people that Yeshua was a Torah observant Jew from Nazareth whose human genealogy is joined to the Patriarchs, the Tribe of Judah, and the royal House of David. Our Jewish Yeshua was crucified, buried, and resurrected according to the Passover template, and soon afterward was "taken up" to the Father. And, as already mentioned, He is the Baptizer with the Holy Spirit-Mt. 3:11-12, the coming Judge of the living and the dead, and the Torah who became flesh-John 1:14. And it is by Elohim's grace that people are saved through faith in Him, His divine Son. Ephesians 2:8. This is the anointed One whom Contender's Voice declares. Keep in mind, dear reader--as you persist in walking in His set-apart paths, expect to be (1) prophetically enlightened, (2) regularly renewed in spirit and soul by way of your discipleship dedication and abiding in His words, (3) inspired by associating with His unfolding prophetic objectives, and (4) greatly blessed in your love-centered friendship-fellowship with Yeshua. Hence, a life of spiritual renewal and refreshing for each of His sheep is yet another aim of Contender's Voice. Reader, believe that you are blessed. Take our motto as your own. Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Hutch Church. Be sure to examine our website.

item.title: Become a Bereanite
item.description: Readers-before going forward please consider these two relative exhortations:
item.content:encoded:
Audio edition of Become a Bereanite on Contender's Voice. For more, visit contendersvoice.com.

Exhortation # 1: Examine the Word of Yahweh.

As you go forward through the site's teachings and blogs, keep in mind that Contender's Voice encourages each person to emulate the study habits of the venerable Berean Jews of Northern Greece. They attended a synagogue in ancient Berea that was being visited by Apostle Paul. While there, he regularly presented the Gospel to the Greek and Judean attendees. Among those in the ancient congregation at that time were ardent Jewish congregants, men who were eager to learn as much about the acclaimed Jewish Messiah as they possibly could. Thus, they carefully examined their Old Covenant scrolls daily to determine if what Paul--the Israelite missionary, taught them about Yeshua was validated by the Torah--and accurate. They were not disappointed. Indeed, Paul's bold proclamations proved entirely trustworthy, since the apostle's teaching was consistently based upon the Jewish Tanakh, the Hebrew Bible--Judaism's fundamental text. So it appears that these Jewish men were seeking confirmation from Yahweh's Torah for transitioning from rabbinic Judaism to the Messiah-based Nazarene faith. Many of them became enlightened and believed Paul's doctrinal presentation of the crucifixion, death, burial, and resurrection of Yeshua, the divine Son of Elohim. Accordingly, a goodly number of those studious and inspired seekers would be (1) converted and become Spirit-born disciples through faIth in Yeshua the Messiah, (2) go on to mature in the impeccable apostolic "faith once for all delivered to the saints" and, most likely, (3) grow in grace and go on to bear much fruit of the Spirit throughout their lives. See: John 3:7; 15:7-8; Jude 1:3.

Exhortation # 2: Emulate the Bereans of Macedonia. 1.5 Minutes

Today's earnest followers of Yeshua are facing a similar type of situation as did the Bereans long ago. I am sure you are aware, dear visitor, that there is a Hebraically centered, Torah restoration movement underway in our nation--of which Contender's Voice is a committed advocate and contributor. In fact, it is a grace-oriented, prophetically-timed Torah-centric revival that is capable of satisfying the fundamental spiritual need of modern believers. And that dire need would be the restoration of the unabridged, full expanse of holy Scripture to the westernized Body of Messiah. Hence, the Holy Spirit is leading these prophetic saints first--to Elohim's unmixed truth, and secondly--to the duty and benefit of un-compromised sanctification. Be sure of this, beloved contender--consecration to Torah-rooted sacred truth is Yahweh's expectation for our lives. Matthew 5:6. Consequently, many believers who know and love Yeshua as their Messiah are measuring this historic Torah recovery phenomenon for possible participation and support. In conclusion, this ministry recommends that every reader of our Web site, manuals, and books follows the example of the Bereans. First, study the Scriptures faithfully under the tutelage of the Holy Spirit. Secondly, prayerfully evaluate everything you read on this site (and others) by comparing it with Yahweh's Word. Thirdly, decide for yourself the validity of the content. Finally, endeavor to honor and fully comply with the truth that (a) Yahweh has made known to you, (b) is applicable to you, and (c) is understood and doable by you. In this way you will be blessed in all your doing. Here's your promise: "For the LORD is a sun and a shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor. No good thing will He withhold from those who walk uprightly" (Psalm 18:11). Tamid Kadima-Always Forward. Shalom.

Contender's Voice is a whole truth restoration service which provides messianic believers with fundamental biblical instruction and prophetic vision. This site, along with our growing blog ministry, is relevant to and thus supports the restoration of Torah-based, Hebraic-oriented truth and practice to the western Ecclesia/Church. Hence, our hands reach out to assist all sincere followers of Messiah Yeshua who intend to make progress in their faith journey. Contender's Voice welcomes these believers and all His saints, both young and older; including people of of every race, tribe, and tongue--including Catholics, Protestants, Evangelicals, Jews, and those not in mainline faiths as well. However, Contender's Voice is particularly designed for (1) the instruction and edification of messianic Christians--the House of Israel returnees, who are transitioning to their Hebraic spiritual heritage and identity, and (2) the recovery and preservation of the un-compromised Torah standards of the apostolic Nazarene faith. To facilitate this prophetically-timed renewal, visionary Spirit-led believers are being enlisted and equipped by the Spirit of Elohim. They are today's faith restoration forerunners who have the responsibility of guarding their recovered heritage from false teachers and faulty doctrines, as did their spiritual forefathers. You may be one of these modern western contenders of truth. I am. So let us not regard the recent election as happenstance. 

Rather it was a referendum and great example of Yahweh's providential care that, in response to prayer,  occurred at a very needful time. The election encourages faith in God and stirs hope for a restoration of spiritual and secular lawfulness to the culture. But the extent of the turnaround is connected directly to the sincerity our repentance, prevailing prayer, and unflagging effort. A national return to constitutional law and order would then be  within reach. What is your opinion, friend? Will the modern Ecclesia--Christendom at large, recognize and welcome Hebraic truth realities into its orthodoxy? This seems unlikely. But a heated mass of Spirit charged particles (saints) is already doing so and it will go forward to contend for and sustain a truth revival. This is the fundamental revival needed.  Thus, teaching converts to go forward and become true disciples of the Messiah and understand the importance of "learning the obedience of the faith" is an important teaching goal of Contenders Voice. 

Matthew 7:21; 28:18-20; Romans 1:6; 16:26; Acts 5:27-32; John 14:15; 1 Peter 1:14; for starters.
